DS_PALAVRA_CHAVE: EMPREENDEDORISMO;MOBILIZAÇÃO DE CAPITAIS;CAMPO E HABITUS;VALE DO SÃO FRANCISCO
DS_ABSTRACT: ENTREPRENEURS ARTICULATE THEMSELVES IN A GIVEN SPACE AND MOBILIZE ECONOMIC, SOCIAL, CULTURAL AND SYMBOLIC CAPITALS. THIS RELATIONSHIP OF USE DETERMINES DISTINCT BEHAVIORS AND FROM THESE CONSTITUTES THE DEVELOPMENT OF SOCIAL DYNAMICS. THE PROBLEM STUDIED HERE REFERS TO HOW ENTREPRENEURS MOBILIZE ECONOMIC, SOCIAL, SYMBOLIC AND CULTURAL CAPITAL FROM BOURDIEU'S PERSPECTIVE AND HOW THEY POSITION THEMSELVES HIERARCHICALLY WITHIN THE PRODUCER MARKET IN JUAZEIRO (BA). THE OBJECTIVE IS TO DESCRIBE THE FIELD AND THE HABITUS WITHIN THE PRODUCER MARKET IN THE LIGHT OF BOURDIEU'S THEORY, BASED ON THE ANALYSIS OF LOCAL DEVELOPMENT DYNAMICS IN THAT MARKET. IN THIS STUDY, EXPLORATORY FIELD RESEARCH WAS USED TO ENABLE THE FAMILIARIZATION OF THE RESEARCHED PROBLEM AND ALSO THE SUBJECTIVE DESCRIPTION OF THE LIVED EXPERIENCE. IN ORDER TO MEET THE PROPOSED OBJECTIVES, WE SOUGHT THE INCLUSION OF PERMIT HOLDERS REGISTERED IN THE NATIONAL REGISTER OF LEGAL ENTITIES (CNPJ) AND THE EXCLUSION OF INFORMAL PERMIT HOLDERS, FROM A NON-PROBABILISTIC SAMPLE FOR CONVENIENCE AND LIMITED BY THE SATURATION TECHNIQUE. THE ANALYTICAL THEORETICAL MODEL OF CAPITALS, THE RESULT OF THIS STUDY, WHICH PRESENTS, THROUGH POSITION AND FLOW, THE HIERARCHY OF MOBILIZED CAPITALS, CONCLUDES THAT THE AGENTS MOBILIZE ECONOMIC, SOCIAL, SYMBOLIC AND CULTURAL CAPITALS, RESPECTIVELY.

DS_RESUMO: EMPREENDEDORES SE ARTICULAM EM DETERMINADO ESPAÇO E MOBILIZAM CAPITAIS ECONÔMICOS, SOCIAIS, CULTURAIS E SIMBÓLICOS. ESTA RELAÇÃO DE USO DETERMINA COMPORTAMENTOS DISTINTOS E A PARTIR, DESTES, CONSTITUI O DESENVOLVIMENTO DE DINÂMICAS SOCIAIS. O PROBLEMA ORA ESTUDADO, REFERE-SE COMO OS EMPREENDEDORES MOBILIZAM OS CAPITAIS ECONÔMICO, SOCIAL, SIMBÓLICO E CULTURAL SOB A PERSPECTIVA DE BOURDIEU E COMO ELES SE POSICIONAM HIERARQUICAMENTE DENTRO DO MERCADO DO PRODUTOR EM JUAZEIRO (BA). O OBJETIVO É DESCREVER O CAMPO E O HABITUS DENTRO DO MERCADO DO PRODUTOR À LUZ DA TEORIA DE BOURDIEU, A PARTIR, DA ANÁLISE EM DINÂMICAS DE DESENVOLVIMENTO LOCAL NO REFERIDO MERCADO. NESTE ESTUDO UTILIZOU-SE A PESQUISA DE CAMPO EXPLORATÓRIA PARA POSSIBILITAR A FAMILIARIZAÇÃO DO PROBLEMA PESQUISADO E AINDA A DESCRIÇÃO SUBJETIVA DA EXPERIÊNCIA VIVIDA. COM O INTUITO DE ATENDER AOS OBJETIVOS PROPOSTOS, BUSCOU-SE A INCLUSÃO DOS PERMISSIONÁRIOS COM REGISTRO NO CADASTRO NACIONAL DE PESSOAS JURÍDICAS (CNPJ) E A EXCLUSÃO DE PERMISSIONÁRIOS INFORMAIS, A PARTIR DE UMA AMOSTRA NÃO PROBABILÍSTICA POR CONVENIÊNCIA E LIMITADA PELA TÉCNICA DE SATURAÇÃO. O MODELO TEÓRICO ANALÍTICO DOS CAPITAIS, RESULTADO DESTE ESTUDO, EM QUE APRESENTA ATRAVÉS DA POSIÇÃO E FLUXO A HIERARQUIA DOS CAPITAIS MOBILIZADOS, CONCLUI-SE QUE OS AGENTES MOBILIZAM OS CAPITAIS ECONÔMICO, SOCIAL, SIMBÓLICO E CULTURAL, RESPECTIVAMENTE.

NM_PRODUCAO: REPERCUSSÃO DA REDE PEBA NA GARANTIA DE ACESSO AO SERVIÇO EM TRAUMATO-ORTOPEDIA
DS_ABSTRACT: THE REGIONALIZATION OF HEALTH IS A GUIDELINE OF THE UNIFIED HEALTH SYSTEM AND A STRUCTURING AXIS OF THE MANAGEMENT PACT THAT GUIDES THE DECENTRALIZATION OF ACTIONS, NEGOTIATION PROCESSES, AND AGREEMENT BETWEEN MANAGERS. THE MIDDLE SAN FRANCISCO VALLEY REGION HAS BEEN NATIONALLY AND INTERNATIONALLY NOTED FOR ITS IRRIGATED FRUIT PRODUCTION. THE SÃO FRANCISCO VALLEY, LOCATED IN THE CENTRAL REGION OF NORTHEASTERN BRAZIL, IS GEOGRAPHICALLY DISTANT FROM THE COUNTRY'S MAJOR MEDICAL CENTERS, AND THUS INITIATIVES AIMED AT DECENTRALIZING HEALTH SERVICES REPRESENT A SIGNIFICANT MEDICAL, SOCIAL, AND ECONOMIC ADVANCEMENT FOR THE REGION. IN THIS CONTEXT, IT IS NECESSARY TO DESCRIBE THE EVOLUTION OF HOSPITALIZATIONS IN TRAUMA-ORTHOPEDICS IN REFERRAL SERVICES, CHECKING IF THERE WERE CHANGES IN ACCESS TO HEALTH SERVICES AT THE REGIONAL LEVEL WITH THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PEBA NETWORK. THIS IS A DESCRIPTIVE, DOCUMENTARY, AND ECOLOGICAL STUDY, WITH A RETROSPECTIVE APPROACH, WITH DATA REFERRING TO HOSPITALIZATIONS IN REFERRAL HOSPITALS, COVERING THE SIX HEALTH REGIONS THAT MAKE UP THE PEBA NETWORK. AS A RESULT, IT IS NOTED THAT THE REFERRAL HOSPITALS IN PERNAMBUCO INCREASED BY 80% THE NUMBER OF HOSPITALIZATIONS IN TRAUMA-ORTHOPEDICS FROM 2011 TO 2018. REFERENCES IN THE STATE OF BAHIA, IN THE SAME PERIOD, SHOWED A 25% REDUCTION IN HOSPITALIZATIONS IN THIS AREA. IT WAS OBSERVED THAT THERE WAS AN INCREASE OF 191.83% OF HOSPITALIZATIONS FROM PERNAMBUCO IN HOSPITALS OF BAHIA AND 568.38% OF BAIANOS HOSPITALIZATIONS IN HOSPITALS OF PERNAMBUCO, EVIDENCED INTERSTATE ACCESS. IT IS UNDERSTOOD THAT THE INCREASE IN HOSPITALIZATIONS FOR TRAUMA-ORTHOPEDICS BETWEEN THE HEALTH REGIONS OF PERNAMBUCO AND BAHIA MAY BE RELATED TO THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE INTERSTATE NETWORK, THE CHANGE OF INSTALLED CAPACITY IN THE HOSPITAL SERVICES, AND THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE BED REGULATION CENTER, CAUSING FAVORABLE REPERCUSSIONS TO USERS' ACCESS TO HEALTH SERVICES.

DS_RESUMO: A REGIONALIZAÇÃO DA SAÚDE É UMA DIRETRIZ DO SISTEMA ÚNICO DE SAÚDE E UM EIXO ESTRUTURANTE DO PACTO DE GESTÃO QUE NORTEIA A DESCENTRALIZAÇÃO DAS AÇÕES, PROCESSOS DE NEGOCIAÇÃO E PACTUAÇÃO ENTRE OS GESTORES. A REGIÃO DO VALE DO MÉDIO SÃO FRANCISCO TEM SE DESTACADO NACIONAL E INTERNACIONALMENTE PELA FRUTICULTURA IRRIGADA. O VALE DO SÃO FRANCISCO, LOCALIZADO NA REGIÃO CENTRAL DO NORDESTE BRASILEIRO, É GEOGRAFICAMENTE DISTANTE DOS GRANDES CENTROS MÉDICOS DO PAÍS E, DESSA MANEIRA INICIATIVAS QUE BUSQUEM A DESCENTRALIZAÇÃO DOS SERVIÇOS DE SAÚDE REPRESENTAM UM GRANDE AVANÇO MÉDICO, SOCIAL E ECONÔMICO PARA A REGIÃO. NESTE CONTEXTO, VISUALIZA-SE A NECESSIDADE DE DESCREVER A EVOLUÇÃO DAS INTERNAÇÕES EM TRAUMATO-ORTOPEDIA NOS SERVIÇOS DE REFERÊNCIA, VERIFICANDO SE HOUVE MUDANÇAS DE ACESSO AOS SERVIÇOS DE SAÚDE A NÍVEL INTERESTADUAL COM A IMPLANTAÇÃO DA REDE PEBA. TRATA-SE DE UM ESTUDO DESCRITIVO, DOCUMENTAL E ECOLÓGICO, DE ABORDAGEM RETROSPECTIVA, COM DADOS REFERENTES AOS INTERNAMENTOS NOS HOSPITAIS DE REFERÊNCIA, CONTEMPLANDO AS SEIS REGIÕES DE SAÚDE QUE INTEGRAM A REDE PEBA. COMO RESULTADO, NOTA-SE QUE OS HOSPITAIS DE REFERÊNCIA EM PERNAMBUCO AUMENTARAM 80% O QUANTITATIVO DE INTERNAÇÕES EM TRAUMATO-ORTOPEDIA DE 2011 A 2018. JÁ AS REFERÊNCIAS NO ESTADO DA BAHIA, NO MESMO PERÍODO, APRESENTARAM UMA REDUÇÃO DE 25% DE INTERNAMENTOS NESSA ÁREA DE ATUAÇÃO. OBSERVOU-SE QUE HOUVE 191,83 % DE AUMENTO DOS INTERNAMENTOS PROCEDENTES DE PERNAMBUCO NOS HOSPITAIS DA BAHIA E DE 568,38% DOS INTERNAMENTOS DOS BAIANOS NOS HOSPITAIS DE PERNAMBUCO, EVIDENCIADO ACESSO INTERESTADUAL. ENTENDE-SE QUE O AUMENTO DAS INTERNAÇÕES POR TRAUMA-ORTOPEDIA ENTRE AS REGIÕES DE SAÚDE DE PERNAMBUCO E BAHIA PODEM ESTAR RELACIONADO À IMPLANTAÇÃO DA REDE INTERESTADUAL, A MUDANÇA DE CAPACIDADE INSTALADA NOS SERVIÇOS HOSPITALARES E A IMPLANTAÇÃO DA CENTRAL DE REGULAÇÃO DE LEITOS, OCASIONANDO REPERCUSSÕES POSITIVAS AO ACESSO DOS PACIENTES AOS SERVIÇOS DE SAÚDE.

DS_ABSTRACT: THE CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY (CSR) IS POINTED IN THE KNOWN LITERATURE AS A BEHAVIOUR THAT A COMPANY MUST HAVE TO DEVELOP AND SUSTAIN COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGES IN A LONG TERM PERIOD. IN THE BUSINESS WORLD THERE IS A RANGE OF NORMATIVE TO GUARANTEE THE LEGALITY OF THE RELATION BETWEEN EMPLOYERS AND WORKERS. THE PURPOSE OF THIS WORK IS TO RESPOND THE FOLLOW QUESTION: WHICH ASPECT OF THE CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY HAS CONTRIBUTED TO BRING JUDICIAL PROCESS TO COURT? IN ORDER TO ANSWER THIS QUESTION, THIS WORK ANALYZED THE JUDICIAL LITIGATION UNDER THE PRISM OF THE CRS. FOR THAT, A QUALITATIVE STUDY WAS REALIZED TAKING AS A BASE THE INFORMATION AVAILABLE IN THE SITE OF REGIONAL COURT OF THE STATE OF PERNAMBUCO IN BRAZIL. FOR THAT, AT FIRST, WE CHECKED THE STATE OF THE ART OF THE TOPICS RELATED TO CSR IN THESPHERE OF THE NATIONAL NORMATIVE AND REGULATION DOCTRINE. IN RELATION TO THE DATA COLLECTED IT WAS DONE BASED ON THE JUDICIAL PROCESSES THAT ENDED WITH ONUS FOR THE EMPLOYER, BETWEEN 2013 AND 2017. IT WAS FOUND THAT IN 99% OF THE PROCESSES THE CLAIMANT WERE THE EMPLOYERS WHICH WERE REPRESENTED IN COURT BY THEIR OWN LOWERS. SYNDICATES (0,29%) AND THE PUBLIC MINISTRY OF WORK (0,88%) HAD LITTLE PARTICIPATION DEFENDING WORKERS IN COURT. WE ALSO FOUND THAT THE NORMATIVE RELATED TO THE WORK AND ITS RELATION WAS THE ONES THAT MOST WERE INFRINGED, ABOUT 78% OF THE CASES. INFRINGEMENT RELATED WITH THE WORK CONDITIONS AND SOCIAL PROTECTION WAS FOUND IN 19% OF THE CASES. FINALLY, PROBLEMS RELATED WITH HEALTH CONDITION AND WORK SECURITY REPRESENTED 3% OF THE PROCESSED ANALYZED. AS A CONSEQUENCE OF THESES INFRACTION WERE INDENTIFIED 32 KINDS OF INDENISATION THAT IN FAVOUR TO THE EMPLOYEE. THE CONCLUSION IS THAT IN THE TENTATIVE OF REDUCE THE BUDGET HAS MAKE THE COMPANIES TO NEGLIGENCE THE BASIC RIGHTS OF THE WORKERS.
DS_RESUMO: A RESPONSABILIDADE SOCIAL EMPRESARIAL (RSE) É APONTADA PELA LITERATURA COMO UM COMPORTAMENTO QUE A EMPRESA DEVE POSSUIR PARA DESENVOLVER E SUSTENTAR VANTAGEM COMPETITIVA NO LONGO PRAZO. NO MUNDO NEGOCIAL EXISTE TODO UM ARCABOUÇO NORMATIVO PARA GARANTIR A LEGALIDADE DE SUAS AÇÕES E PARA SERVIR DE INSTRUMENTO BALIZADOR DE PODER ENTRE EMPRESÁRIO E O OBREIRO. NESSE CONTEXTO, BUSCOU-SE RESPONDER AO SEGUINTE QUESTIONAMENTO: QUE ASPECTOS DA RESPONSABILIDADE SOCIAL EMPRESARIAL TÊM CONTRIBUÍDO PARA O AJUIZAMENTO DE AÇÕES NA JUSTIÇA DO TRABALHO? PARA RESPONDER A ESSE QUESTIONAMENTO ESTABELECEU-SE COMO OBJETIVO ANALISAR OS LITÍGIOS JUDICIAIS RESULTANTES DAS RELAÇÕES DE EMPREGO SOB O PRISMA DA RESPONSABILIDADE SOCIAL EMPRESARIAL (RSE). PARA TANTO, FOI REALIZADO UM ESTUDO QUALITATIVO COM BASE EM DADOS PÚBLICOS DO SITE DO TRIBUNAL REGIONAL DO TRABALHO DO ESTADO DE PERNAMBUCO. INICIALMENTE FOI LEVANTADO O ESTADO DA ARTE DO TEMA RSE, COM BUSCA DE INFORMAÇÕES NA DOUTRINA E NAS NORMATIVAS NACIONAIS. NO QUE TANGE A COLETA DE DADOS, ESTA FOI REALIZADA POR MEIO DOS ACÓRDÃOS CONDENATÓRIOS, JULGADOS EM PREJUÍZO DOS EMPRESÁRIOS, QUE FORAM PROLATADOS NO PERÍODO DE 2013 ATÉ 2017. CONSTATOU-SE QUE EM QUASE 99% DOS PROCESSOS OS RECLAMANTES SÃO OS PRÓPRIOS EMPREGADOS REPRESENTADOS POR SEUS ADVOGADOS, ENQUANTO QUE SINDICATOS (0,29%) E O MINISTÉRIO PÚBLICO DO TRABALHO (0,88%) TEM PARTICIPAÇÃO BASTANTE REDUZIDA NA DEFESA DE DIREITOS DOS TRABALHADORES NA ESFERA JUDICIAL. TAMBÉM VERIFICOU-SE QUE DIRETRIZES RELACIONADAS AO EMPREGO E PRÁTICAS DE TRABALHO FORAM AS MAIS INFRIGIDAS, ALCANÇANDO 78% DAS RECLAMAÇÕES ANALISADAS. EM SEGUIDA, INFRAÇÕES ÀS ORIENTAÇÕES ASSOCIADAS ÀS CONDIÇÕES DE TRABALHO E PROTEÇÃO SOCIAL FORAM IDENTIFICADAS EM 19% DOS PROCESSOS. E, POR FIM, PRECEITOS ATINENTES À SAÚDE E SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO FORAM OBSERVADOS EM 3% DOS LITÍGIOS. COMO CONSEQUÊNCIA A ESSAS INFRAÇÕES FORAM IDENTIFICADAS 32 DIFERENTES CONCESSÕES AOS TRABALHADORES COMO INDENIZAÇÃO PECUNIÁRIA PELO DANO SOFRIDO. CONCLUI-SE QUE A BUSCA DA REDUÇÃO DE GASTOS PELAS EMPRESAS TEM LEVADO ESSAS ENTIDADES A NEGLIGENCIAR OS DIREITOS MAIS BÁSICOS DOS TRABALHADORES APONTANDO NA DIREÇÃO DO DESRESPEITO PELO ESTADO DE DIREITO E DO ROMPIMENTO DO CONTRATO SOCIAL PRESENTE NA SOCIEDADE, SEM AS QUAIS RESTAM PREJUDICADAS A JUSTIÇA, A ESTABILIDADE E A PAZ SOCIAL.

DS_ABSTRACT: THE PURPOSE OF THIS WORK WAS TO ANALYZE, FROM A TECHNICAL AND SOCIOECONOMIC POINT OF VIEW, THE RESULTS OBTAINED IN THE PROPERTIES SINCE THE INTERVENTIONS OF THE "SOBRADINHO LAKE PROJECT". TO THEORETICALLY SUPPORT THE STUDY, THE CONCEPTS AND THEMES ADOPTED WERE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS, SUSTAINABLE TERRITORIAL DEVELOPMENT, AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER, TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE AND RURAL EXTENSION. THE QUALITATIVE AND QUANTITATIVE EXPLORATORY FIELD RESEARCH WAS ADOPTED. THE INFORMATION WAS OBTAINED THROUGH A BIBLIOGRAPHIC AND DOCUMENTARY REVIEW AND THE DATA COLLECTED THROUGH SEMISTRUCTURED INTERVIEWS AIDED BY FORMS, APPLIED IN THE 60 PRODUCTIVE UNITS OF THE PROJECTIN THE MUNICIPALITIES OF CASA NOVA, PILÃO ARCADO, REMANSO, SENTO SÉ AND SOBRADINHO IN THE ESTADO OF BAHIA. FROM THE RESULTS OBTAINED, IT IS POSSIBLE TO STATE THAT THE METHODOLOGICAL PROCEDURES OF TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER USED BY THE LAGO DE SOBRADINHO PROJECT IN THE FIVE MUNICIPALITIES WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR SIGNIFICANT CHANGES IN ASSISTED PROPERTIES.IT CAN BE CONCLUDED THAT THE PROJECT RESPECTED THE REALITY OF THE PRODUCERS AND THE CHARACTERISTICS OF EACH PROPERTY, IN ORDER TO PROVIDE THE ECONOMIC PROFIT, BY GENERATING INCOME FOR THE PRODUCERS AND THEIR FAMILIES. ALSO ENABLING SOCIAL PROFIT BY RESCUING THE SELF-ESTEEM OF THE PRODUCER AND PROVIDE BETTER QUALITY OF LIFE FOR HIS FAMILY, SETTING MEN IN RURAL AREAS WITH OPPORTUNITIES FOR FINANCIAL GROWTH. AND, FINALLY, THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROFIT BY ALLOWING THE RATIONAL AND INTENSIVE EXPLOITATION OF THE LAND, MITIGATING THE ENVIRONMENTAL DEGRADATION, THUS ENABLING THE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT OF RURAL COMMUNITIES AROUND THE SOBRADINHO DAM.

A PARTIR DOS RESULTADOS OBTIDOS, É POSSÍVEL AFIRMAR QUE, OS PROCEDIMENTOS METODOLÓGICOS DE TRANSFERÊNCIA DE TECNOLOGIA UTILIZADOS PELO PROJETO LAGO DE SOBRADINHO NOS CINCO MUNICÍPIOS FORAM RESPONSÁVEIS POR MUDANÇAS SIGNIFICATIVAS NAS PROPRIEDADES ASSISTIDAS. E, POR FIM, O LUCRO AMBIENTAL, AO PERMITIR A EXPLORAÇÃO RACIONAL E INTENSIVA DA TERRA, MITIGANDO A DEGRADAÇÃO AMBIENTAL, VIABILIZANDO, ASSIM, O DESENVOLVIMENTO SUSTENTÁVEL DAS COMUNIDADES RURAIS NO ENTORNO DA BARRAGEM DE SOBRADINHO.

DS_ABSTRACT: THE PURPOSE OF THIS WORK WAS TO STUDY THE USE OF INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGIES WITH FAMILY FARMERS IN THE SUB-MEDIUM OF SÃO FRANCISCO. AS A RESULT OF THE ANALYZES, A MOBILE APPLICATION WAS DEVELOPED TO HELP THE PRODUCER TO CONTROL AND MANAGE THE ACTIVITIES AND COSTS OF THE RURAL ENTERPRISE. . FOR THIS WORK A BIBLIOGRAPHIC RESEARCH WAS CARRIED OUT IN ORDER TO EXPLORE ABOUT ESSENTIAL THEMES FOR THE RESEARCH. IN THIS CONTEXT WERE DISCUSSED TOPICS ON: FAMILY FARMING, INNOVATION STRATEGIES, INDUSTRY 4.0, DIGITAL AGRICULTURE, THE FUTURE OF AGRIBUSINESS AND MOBILE APPLICATIONS. SECONDLY, QUESTIONNAIRES WERE APPLIED TO SPECIALISTS AND PRODUCERS IN ORDER TO BETTER UNDERSTAND THE REALITY, DIFFICULTIES, EXPECTATIONS AND THE DYNAMICS OF THE USE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGIES IN FAMILY FARMING IN THE SUB-MEDIUM OF SÃO FRANCISCO. AFTER ANALYSIS OF THE RESULTS IT WAS PROPOSED, FROM THE INFORMATION COLLECTED AND ANALYZED FROM THE PREVIOUS STEPS, AND DEVELOPED A MOBILE APPLICATION. THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE APPLICATION WAS BASED ON REQUIREMENTS GATHERING, CLASS DIAGRAMMING AND SCREEN PROTOTYPING. CONCEPTS OF AGILE PROGRAMMING METHODS WERE USED IN ORDER TO GIVE OBJECTIVITY AND SPEED TO DEVELOPMENT. THE TOOL USED FOR DEVELOPMENT WAS IONIC. AFTER COMPLETION, THE APPLICATION WAS SUBMITTED TO AN EVALUATION WITH FAMILY FARMERS. AS A RESULT OF THIS RESEARCH AN APPLICATION WAS DEVELOPED TO SUPPORT THE FAMILY FARMER'S FIELD ACTIVITIES AND COSTS.

DS_ABSTRACT: PERIODS OF DROUGHT IN SEMIARID REGIONS THE FORAGE PALM BECOMES ONE OF THE BEST SOURCES OF ENERGY AND WATER FOR RUMINANT NUTRITION HOWEVER, THIS PLANT DOES NOT MEET THE NUTRITIONAL REQUIREMENTS OF THE HERD, SUCH AS FIBER AND PROTEIN, SO IT BECOMES NECESSARY TO USE OTHER BULKY FOODS AND PROTEIN SOURCES. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS STUDY WAS TO EVALUATE THE FERMENTATIVE AND BROMATOLOGICAL PROFILE OF THE MEXICAN ELEPHANT EAR (OPUNTIA STRICTA HAW) PALM SILAGE WITH PROTEIN AND FIBER SOURCES, AS WELL AS THE CONSUMPTION AND WEIGHT GAIN OF SHEEP CONFINED TO THESE SILAGES. THE FERMENTATION PROFILE OF THE SILAGES WAS PERFORMED IN A MINI-SILO WITH OPENING AT 75 DAYS IN A COMPLETELY RANDOMIZED DESIGN. FOUR TREATMENTS WERE MADE: CORN SILAGE AS A CONTROL AND PALM SILAGE WITH 1% UREA AND A 20% INCLUSION OF GLIRICIDIA HAY OR HAY OF PORNUNÇA OR IN NATURA SUGAR CANE BAGASSE. THE VARIABLES STUDIED WERE GAS LOSS; EFFLUENT LOSS; TOTAL DRY MATTER LOSS; DRY MATTER RECOVERY; PH AND CONCENTRATIONS OF ORGANIC ACIDS (ACETIC, PROPIONIC, LACTIC AND BUTYRIC ACIDS) DRY MATTER CONTENT; CRUDE PROTEIN; MINERAL MATTER AND TOTAL DIGESTIBLE NUTRIENTS. IN ADDITION, 20 MALE DORPER MONGREL SHEEP WITH MEAN LIVE WEIGHT OF 13 KG AND AVERAGE AGE OF SIX MONTHS WERE RANDOMLY ASSIGNED TO FOUR TREATMENTS OF SILAGE MENTIONED ABOVE AND ALSO THE ACEROLA BRAN ADDED IN THE CONCENTRATE AS SOURCE OF FIBER IN ISOPROTEIN AND ISOFIBROUS DIETS. THE EXPERIMENTAL DATA WERE ANALYZED USING ANALYSIS OF VARIANCE (P <0.05). THE RESULTS SHOWED THAT THERE WAS INFLUENCE OF TREATMENTS (P <0.05) ON THE DRY MATTER INTAKE (DMI). THE TREATMENT THAT OBTAINED THE LOWEST INTAKE WAS THE MOST PORNUNÇA PALM (1126 G/DAY). IT WAS OBSERVED A DIFFERENCE (P <0.05) BETWEEN THE TREATMENTS FOR THE VARIABLES: DRY MATTER DIGESTIBILITY (DMS) AND CONSUMPTION OF NEUTRAL DETERGENT FIBER (CFDN), IT IS OBSERVED THAT THE TREATMENT 100% CORN SILAGE PRESENTED THE HIGHEST VALUE , THE TREATMENT OF 2-PALM SILAGE + SUGARCANE BAGASSE + UREA APPROACHED THE VALUE OF THE CONTROL WITH 69.20% IN DRY MATTER DIGESTIBILITY (71.4% AND 645.00 G/DAY FOR CFDN). ACCORDING TO THE ANALYZED PARAMETERS, THE FORAGE PALM SILAGE THAT MOST APPROACHED THE FERMENTATION QUALITY AND THE ANIMAL PERFORMANCE RECEIVING CORN SILAGE WAS THE TREATMENT WITH BAGASSE OF SUGARCANE AND UREA AS RESPECTIVE SOURCES OF FIBER AND CRUDE PROTEIN, WITH GAIN OF AVERAGE WEIGHT OF 154 G/DAY.

DS_RESUMO: PERÍODOS DE ESTIAGEM EM REGIÕES SEMIÁRIDAS A PALMA FORRAGEIRA TORNA-SE UMA DAS MELHORES FONTES DE ENERGIA E DE ÁGUA PARA A NUTRIÇÃO DE RUMINANTES. CONTUDO ESSA PLANTA NÃO ATENDE AS EXIGÊNCIAS NUTRICIONAIS DO REBANHO, QUANTO A FIBRA E A PROTEÍNA, ENTÃO TORNA-SE NECESSÁRIO O USO DE OUTROS ALIMENTOS VOLUMOSOS E FONTES PROTEICAS. OBJETIVOU-SE COM ESTE ESTUDO, AVALIAR O PERFIL FERMENTATIVO E BROMATOLÓGICO DA SILAGEM DE PALMA ORELHA DE ELEFANTE MEXICANA (OPUNTIA STRICTA HAW) COM FONTES DE PROTEÍNA E FIBRA, ASSIM COMO O CONSUMO E GANHO DE PESO DE OVINOS CONFINADOS COM ESSAS SILAGENS. O PERFIL FERMENTATIVO DAS SILAGENS FOI REALIZADO EM MINI-SILO COM ABERTURA AOS 75 DIAS EM DELINEAMENTO INTEIRAMENTE CASUALIZADO. QUATRO TRATAMENTOS FORAM CONFECCIONADOS: SILAGEM DE MILHO COMO TESTEMUNHO E SILAGEM DE PALMA COM 1% DE UREIA E MAIS 20% DE INCLUSÃO DE FENO DE GLIRICÍDIA OU FENO DE PORNUNÇA OU BAGAÇO IN NATURA DE CANA-DE-AÇÚCAR. DS_ABSTRACT: THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PRESENT WORK WAS THE EFFECT OF DIFFERENT WATER VOLUME, IRRIGATION FREQUENCIES, PLANTING DENSITIES AND CUT INTENSITIES IN THE PRODUCTIVE INDUSTRIES AND IN THE INTERIOR OF THE OPUNTIA STRICTA (HAW) HAW PALM IN CONDITIONS OF WATER SUPPLEMENTATION. THIS STUDY WAS COMPOSED OF THREE EXPERIMENTAL TRIALS. IN THE FIRST THE WATER VOLUME (100%, 75%, 50% AND 25% OF ETC) AND THREE IRRIGATION FREQUENCIES (7, 14 AND 28 DAYS BETWEEN IRRIGATIONS) WERE EVALUATED IN A RANDOMIZED COMPLETE BLOCK DESIGN WITH FIVE REPLICATIONS, IN SUBDIVIDED PLOTS (4X3). THE MOST FREQUENT IRRIGATION INCREASED THE THICKNESS OF THE TOTAL CLADODE AND REDUCED THE DRY MATTER (MS) IN THE 100% REPLACEMENT OF ETC. THE 100% ETC REPLACEMENT EVERY SEVEN DAYS WAS MORE FREQUENT, BUT DID NOT DIFFER FROM THE FREQUENCY EVERY 14 DAYS. THE FREQUENCY HAD A SIGNIFICANT INFLUENCE ON THE BASE CLADODE THICKNESS AND THE NUMBER OF CLADODES PER PLANT. THERE WAS ALSO AN INCREASE IN WATER USE EFFICIENCY (WUE) AS THE VOLUME APPLIED REDUCED. NO DIFFERENCES WERE OBSERVED FOR THE VARIABLES HEIGHT AND WIDTH OF PLANT, LENGTH, WIDTH, AND AREA INDEX OF CLADODES, PLANT WEIGHT, GREEN PRODUCTIVITY (GP) AND DRY (DP) YIELD, FORAGE ACCUMULATION RATE (FAR) AND CHEMICAL COMPOSITION. THE IRRIGATION WATER VOLUME AND FREQUENCIES CHANGED THE VARIABLES IN THE GROWTH OF OPUNTIA STRICTA (HAW.) HAW, WITHOUT AFFECTING THEIR PRODUCTIVITY. IN THE SECOND EXPERIMENT, THREE CUTTING INTENSITIES (CBASAL), CUT WITH ONLY PRIMARY ORDER PRESERVATION (CPRIM), AND CUT WITH SECONDARY ORDER PRESERVATION (CSEC) WERE EVALUATED. THE EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN WAS A RANDOMIZED BLOCK DESIGN WITH EIGHT REPLICATIONS. THERE WAS AN INCREASE IN PLANT HEIGHT AND WIDTH IN CPRIM AND CSEC IN RELATION TO CBASAL. THE PLANT WIDTH FOR CSEC WAS LARGER THAN CPRIM. THE THICKNESS OF PRIMARY CLADODES WAS HIGHER IN CPRIM AND CSEC COMPARED TO CBASAL, AND THERE WAS NO EFFECT FOR THE OTHER THICKNESSES. THE NUMBER OF GENERAL, TERTIARY AND QUATERNARY CLADODES, GENERAL, SECONDARY, TERTIARY AND QUATERNARY CLADODE AREA INDEX (CAI) INCREASED AS LESS CUTS WERE APPLIED, AND THERE WAS NO EFFECT FOR THE OTHER NUMBERS AND CAI. FOR THE PRODUCTIVE VARIABLES, THE CPRIM AND CSEC PRESENTED DIFFERENCES AMONG THEMSELVES ONLY IN THE TERTIARY CLADODE WEIGHT (TCW), CPRIM AND CBASAL ARE DIFFERENT FROM EACH OTHER FOR MOST VARIABLES, EXCEPT FOR TCW, AND CBASAL AND CSEC ARE DIFFERENT FROM EACH OTHER, EXCEPT IN THE WEIGHT HARVESTED PER PLANT AND GP. THE VEGETATIVE GROWTH AND YIELD OF OPUNTIA STRICTA (HAW.) HAW, RECEIVING WATER SUPPLEMENTATION, IS INFLUENCED BY THE CUT INTENSITY. IN THE THIRD EXPERIMENT DIFFERENT CULTIVATION DENSITIES (20,000, 25,000, 33,333, 50,000 AND 100,000 PLANTS / HA) WERE EVALUATED USING THE RANDOMIZED BLOCK DESIGN WITH FOUR REPLICATIONS. THE INCREASE IN DENSITY PROMOTED A LINEAR DECREASING EFFECT ON PLANT HEIGHT, WIDTH AND MASS, NUMBER OF PRIMARY, SECONDARY, TERTIARY AND GENERAL CLADODES. AT THE SAME TIME IT PROMOTED INCREASING LINEAR EFFECT IN THE CAI, IN GP AND DP, WUE, AND FAR. THERE WAS A QUADRATIC EFFECT FOR THE THICKNESS OF CLADODES AND DM CONTENT. THE INCREASE IN PLANTING DENSITY OF OPUNTIA STRICTA (HAW.) HAW PROMOTES CHANGES IN THE STRUCTURAL CHARACTERISTICS, INFLUENCING ITS PRODUCTIVITY.

O AUMENTO DA DENSIDADE PROMOVEU EFEITO LINEAR DECRESCENTE NA ALTURA, LARGURA, MASSA DA PLANTA, NÚMERO DE CLADÓDIOS PRIMÁRIOS, SECUNDÁRIOS, TERCIÁRIOS E GERAL. AO MESMO TEMPO QUE PROMOVEU EFEITO LINEAR CRESCENTE NO IAC, NA PV, PS, EUA, E TAF. HOUVE EFEITO QUADRÁTICO PARA ESPESSURA DE CLADÓDIOS E TEOR DE MS. DS_ABSTRACT: THE PRESENT WORK HAD THE OBJECTIVE OF CHARACTERIZING AND TYPIFYING THE WATERS OF THE PETROLINA-PE UNDERGROUND WELLS, AIMING AT POTENTIAL USE IN ANIMAL PRODUCTION. THE STUDY WAS CARRIED IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PETROLINA IN THE EARLY PERIOD OF THE RAINY SEASON (DECEMBER 2017) AT THE BEGINNING OF THE DRY PERIOD (JUNE 2018). IT WAS EVALUATED 77 WELLS, THE EQUIVALENT OF 10.00% OF THE EXISTING WELLS IN THE MUNICIPALITY. ALL THE WELLS WERE GEOREFERENCED, MAKING TWO SAMPLES FOR ANALYSIS IN ALL WELLS DRAWN. CATIONS WERE ANALYZED: CALCIUM (CA), MAGNESIUM (MG), SODIUM (NA), POTASSIUM (K); AND THE ANIONS: CARBONATE (CO3-), BICARBONATE (HCO3-), SULFATE (SO4-) AND CHLORINE (CL). THE HYDROGEN IONIC POTENTIAL (PH), THE SODIUM ADSORPTION RATIO (RAS), THE HARDNESS AND THE ELECTRICAL CONDUCTIVITY IN THE EMBRAPA SEMIARID WATER ANALYSIS LABORATORY WERE ALSO MEASURED. THE LABORATORY DATA WERE ANALYZED STATISTICALLY USING THE MULTIVARIATE ANALYSIS USING SAS (STATISTICAL ANALYSIS SYSTEM) SOFTWARE, VERSION 9.4, AND THE PROCEDURES FACTOR AND UIM, Ç. ~;] / CLUSTER (SAS / STAT, 2014). FOR THE INTERPOLATION OF THE IMPAS DATA, THE STATISTICAL MODEL CALLED "INVERSE OF DISTANCES" WAS USED. THE VARIABLES THAT STRONGLY DIFFERENTIATED THE GROUNDWATER IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PETROLINA WERE CHLORINE (CL-) AND MAGNESIUM (MG) AND THEIR CONCENTRATIONS WERE ALTERED ACCORDING TO THE TIME OF YEAR, AS IN DECEMBER AND JUNE. THE CLUSTER ANALYSIS IDENTIFIED THREE QUALITATIVE WATER GROUPS, WHICH PRESENTED SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THEM. THE MEAN VALUES FOUND IN DECEMBER 2017 FOR ELECTRICAL CONDUCTIVITY (DS / M), SDT (G / L) AND RAS FOR GROUPS 1, 2 AND 3 WERE: 2.36, 5.89 AND 9.44; 1.52, 4.71 AND 7.55 AND 2.07, 2.95 AND 3.25, RESPECTIVELY. IN JUNE 2018 THEY WERE 2.26, 6.05 AND 12.28; 1.45, 4.58 AND 9.82, 2.23, 3.16 AND 3.12 FOR THE SAME PARAMETERS AND GROUPS IN THE SAME ORDERS. IT CAN BE ATTRIBUTED ONLY THREE GROUPS OF WATERS IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PETROLINA-PE, WHICH DIFFER MUCH MORE BY CONDUCTIVITY, CONCENTRATED BETWEEN C3 AND C4, THAN BY THE SODICITY THAT PRESENTED ITS HIGH CONCENTRATION IN S1 - "LOW RISK OF SODIFICATION. THE USE OF THESE WATERS IN ANIMAL PRODUCTION AND OTHER USES SHOULD BE ORIENTAD BY THE SCIENTIFIC INFORMATION AVAILABLE ON THE SUBJECT.

DS_ABSTRACT: THE INTENSE USE OF ANTHELMINTIC TO VERMIN IN SHEEP AS THE MAIN CONTROL MEASURE HAS CONTRIBUTED TO THE INCREASING PRESENCE OF MULTIRESISTANT NEMATODES, MAKING ANTHELMINTIC RESISTANCE A FACTOR OF GREAT IMPORTANCE IN SHEEP PRODUCTION DUE TO THE NUMEROUS LOSSES IN THE BRAZILIAN HERDS. IN THIS CONTEXT, THE OBJECTIVE WAS TO INVESTIGATE THE OCCURRENCE OF GASTROINTESTINAL NEMATODES RESISTANCE TO COMMERCIAL DRUGS IN SHEEP HERDS AND TO CHARACTERIZE THE PROPERTIES LOCATED IN IRRIGATED AND RAINFED AREAS IN THE SEMI-ARID PERNAMBUCANO. THE TESTS WERE CARRIED OUT IN TEN RURAL FARMS WHERE 36 ADULT SHEEP WERE SELECTED AND SIX ANIMALS WERE DISTRIBUTED IN SIX TREATMENTS, CONSISTING OF ANTHELMINTICS, IVERMECTIN 0.08%, ALBENDAZOLE 10%, LEVAMISOLE 5%, MOXIDECTIN 1% AND CLOSANTEL 10%. THE EFFICACY CALCULATION WAS PERFORMED USING THE EGG REDUCTION PER GRAM OF FECES (OPG) AND FOR THE IDENTIFICATION OF THE NEMATODE SPECIES, THE COPROCULTURE WAS PERFORMED. FOR THE CHARACTERIZATION OF THE CONDITIONS OF CREATION AND MANAGEMENT OF THE ANIMALS WERE APPLIED, TOGETHER WITH THE PRODUCERS, QUESTIONNAIRES DURING THE VISITS. OF THE SANITARY MANAGEMENT PRACTICES IDENTIFIED, THE MISUSE OF AVAILABLE DRUGS WAS ONE OF THE FACTORS, ASSOCIATED WITH A LOW LEVEL OF TECHNOLOGY IN MOST PROPERTIES. MOXIDECTIN PRESENTED HIGHER EFFICACY (REDUCTION OF 90%). OVERALL, MOXIDECTIN AND CLOSANTEL AVERAGED 87.9% (10/360) AND 83.9% (10/360), RESPECTIVELY, ON THE PROPERTIES. THE DRUGS IVERMECTIN, LEVAMISOLE AND ALBENDAZOLE WERE INEFFECTIVE IN THE HERDS OF ALL EVALUATED PROPERTIES, SUGGESTING THE PRESENCE OF MULTIRESISTANT PARASITES. IN THE IRRIGATED AND DRY LAND AREAS, THE GENERAL AVERAGE OF ALL DRUGS WAS 31.2% (5/180) AND 49.2% (5/180), RESPECTIVELY, INDICATING A GREATER EFFICACY IN THE PROPERTIES IN THE RAINFED AREA. FROM THE RECOVERY OF LARVAE, IT WAS OBSERVED THAT HAEMONCHUS CONTORTUS WAS THE MOST PREVALENT PARASITE IN THE POPULATION RESISTANT TO ANTHELMINTICS ADMINISTERED, FOLLOWED BY TRICHOSTRONGYLUS SPP., OESOPHAGOSTOMUM SPP. AND STRONGYLOIDES PAPILLOSUS.

DS_RESUMO: A UTILIZAÇÃO INTENSA DE ANTI-HELMÍNTICOS À VERMINOSE EM OVINOS COMO PRINCIPAL MEDIDA DE CONTROLE VEM COLABORANDO PARA A CRESCENTE PRESENÇA DE NEMATÓDEOS MULTIRRESISTENTES, TORNANDO A RESISTÊNCIA ANTI-HELMÍNTICA UM FATOR DE GRANDE IMPORTÂNCIA NA OVINOCULTURA PELOS INÚMEROS PREJUÍZOS NOS REBANHOS BRASILEIROS. NESSE CONTEXTO, OBJETIVOU-SE INVESTIGAR A OCORRÊNCIA DA RESISTÊNCIA DOS NEMATÓDEOS GASTRINTESTINAIS FRENTE A MEDICAMENTOS COMERCIAIS, EM REBANHOS OVINOS E CARACTERIZAR AS PROPRIEDADES LOCALIZADAS EM ÁREAS IRRIGADA E DE SEQUEIRO NO SEMIÁRIDO PERNAMBUCANO. OS TESTES FORAM REALIZADOS EM DEZ PROPRIEDADES RURAIS, ONDE FORAM SELECIONADOS 36 OVINOS ADULTOS, DISTRIBUINDO SEIS ANIMAIS EM SEIS TRATAMENTOS, CONSTITUÍDOS PELOS ANTI-HELMÍNTICOS, IVERMECTINA 0,08%, ALBENDAZOLE 10%, LEVAMISOLE 5%, MOXIDECTINA 1% E CLOSANTEL 10%. A ANÁLISE PELO CÁLCULO DA EFICÁCIA FOI REALIZADA UTILIZANDO-SE O TESTE DE REDUÇÃO DE OVOS POR GRAMA DE FEZES (OPG) E PARA IDENTIFICAÇÃO DAS ESPÉCIES DE NEMATÓDEOS REALIZOU-SE A COPROCULTURA. PARA A CARACTERIZAÇÃO DAS CONDIÇÕES DE CRIAÇÃO E MANEJO DOS ANIMAIS FORAM APLICADOS, JUNTO AOS PRODUTORES, QUESTIONÁRIOS NO DECORRER DAS VISITAS. DAS PRÁTICAS DE MANEJO SANITÁRIO IDENTIFICADO, O MAU USO DOS FÁRMACOS DISPONÍVEIS FOI UM DOS FATORES, ASSOCIADO A UM BAIXO NÍVEL DE TECNOLOGIA NA MAIORIA DAS PROPRIEDADES. MOXIDECTINA APRESENTOU MAIOR EFICÁCIA (REDUÇÃO DE 90%), DE MODO GERAL A MÉDIA DA MOXIDECTINA E CLOSANTEL CONFIRMOU 87,9% (10/360) E 83,9% (10/360), RESPECTIVAMENTE NAS PROPRIEDADES. DS_PALAVRA_CHAVE: CITOMETRIA DE FLUXO;CRESCIMENTO;CHOQUE DE TEMPERATURA;INDUÇÃO DE TRIPLOIDIA
DS_ABSTRACT: THIS STUDY EVALUATED DOUBLE THERMAL SHOCK TO INDUCE TRIPLOIDIA IN TAMBAQUI (COLOSSOMA MACROPOMUM) AND COMPARED THE PERFORMANCE (IN TERMS OF SURVIVAL AND GROWTH) PERFORMANCE OF DIPLOID AND TRIPLOID FISH. AFTER ARTIFICIAL REPRODUCTION, NEWLY FERTILIZED OOCYTES WERE SUBJECTED TO HOT THERMAL SHOCKS (40 AND 42°C) FOR TWO MINUTES AND THEN TO COLD SHOCK (4°C) FOR 25 MINUTES. INTACT OOCYTES WERE USED AS CONTROLS. BIOMETRICS WERE PERFORMED TO EVALUATE THE REPRODUCTIVE PARAMETERS (FERTILIZATION AND SURVIVAL RATE) AND PRODUCTIVE (WEIGHT GAIN, DAILY WEIGHT GAIN, SPECIFIC GROWTH RATE AND CONDITION FACTOR). THE LEVEL OF PLOIDY WAS CONFIRMED BY FLOW CYTOMETRY. USING A CYFLOW SPACE (MÜSTER, GERMANY) CYTOMETER EQUIPPED WITH A 488 NN LASER CANON. RELATIVE FLUORESCENCE HISTOGRAMS WERE ANALYZED USING FLOMAX 2.3 SOFTWARE. THE EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN WAS COMPLETELY RANDOMIZED WITH THREE TREATMENTS AND THREE REPLICATES. A TOTAL OF 270 LARVAE OF TAMBAQUIS WITH INITIAL MEAN WEIGHT OF 0.0010 ± 0.0001 MILLIGRAMS WERE USED, DISTRIBUTED IN NINE CIRCULAR POLYETHYLENE BOXES WITH A CAPACITY OF 500 LITERS OF USEFUL VOLUME. EACH EXPERIMENTAL UNIT CONTAINED 30 LARVAE. STANDARDIZED STATISTICAL PROCEDURES WERE USED FOR DATA PROCESSING USING THE EXPDES STATISTICAL PACKAGE. PT IN THE STATISTICAL SOFTWARE R. THE DATA WERE SUBMITTED TO THE NORMALITY TEST OF SHAPIRO-WILK RESIDUES AND EXPRESSED AS MEAN ± SEM. THE COMPARISON OF THE GROUPS REGARDING WEIGHT GAIN, DAILY AVERAGE WEIGHT GAIN, SPECIFIC GROWTH RATE AND CONDITION FACTOR OF DIPLOID AND TRIPLOID FISH WAS DONE USING ANOVA, FOLLOWED BY THE TUKEY TEST. DIFFERENCES WERE CONSIDERED SIGNIFICANT WHEN (P <0.05). FERTILIZATION AND SURVIVAL WERE REDUCED IN THE GROUPS TREATED WITH TEMPERATURE (P <0.05).THE TEMPERATURE 42/4 °C INDUCED 35% OF TRIPLOID NUCLEI, WHILE THE TEMPERATURE 40/4 °C WAS NOT EFFECTIVE FOR TRIPLOIDIZATION. THUS, THE GROUP 42/4 °C WAS THE BEST TREATMENT THAT PRODUCED TAMBAQUI LARVAE WITH HIGHER INITIAL AVERAGE WEIGHT WHEN COMPARED TO THE CONDITION AT 40/4 °C AND WITHOUT ANY HEAT TREATMENT, THIS SAME PERFORMANCE REMAINED UNTIL THE END OF THE STUDY AND IN THE JUVENILE PHASE. CONCLUDING THAT, THE TEMPERATURE OF 42/4 °C AS A CAUSAL AGENT CAN BE USED FOR THE PRODUCTION OF TRIPLOID FISH, AIMING THE GENERATION OF GENETICALLY IMPROVED ANIMALS, CONTRIBUTING TO THE IMPROVEMENT OF THE VARIABLES OF ZOOTECHNICAL PERFORMANCE, THROUGH ANIMALS WITH HIGHER GROWTH VELOCITY AND WEIGHT GAIN AS DEMONSTRATED IN THIS STUDY.

DS_RESUMO: ESTE ESTUDO AVALIOU O CHOQUE TÉRMICO DUPLO PARA INDUZIR A TRIPLOIDIA EM TAMBAQUI (COLOSSOMA MACROPOMUM) E COMPAROU A TAXA DE FERTILIZAÇÃO E VARIÁVEIS DE DESEMPENHO (EM TERMOS DE SOBREVIVÊNCIA E CRESCIMENTO) DE PEIXES DIPLOIDES E TRIPLOIDES. FORAM UTILIZADAS 270 LARVAS DE TAMBAQUIS COM PESO MÉDIO INICIAL DE 0,0010 ± 0,0001 MG, DISTRIBUÍDAS EM NOVE CAIXAS DE POLIETILENO CIRCULARES, COM CAPACIDADE DE 500 LITROS DE VOLUME ÚTIL. AS DIFERENÇAS FORAM CONSIDERADAS SIGNIFICATIVAS QUANDO (P<0,05). A TAXA DE FERTILIZAÇÃO E SOBREVIVÊNCIA FORAM REDUZIDAS NOS GRUPOS TRATADOS COM TEMPERATURAS DE 40 E 42°C. O PESO INICIAL E O CRESCIMENTO INICIAL NA FASE LARVAL MOSTRARAM MELHORES DESEMPENHOS NO GRUPO 42/4°C (TRIPLOIDE) DO QUE NOS GRUPOS 40/4°C E CONTROLE (DIPLOIDE), RESPECTIVAMENTE. O GRUPO 42/4°C MOSTROU DESEMPENHOS DE CRESCIMENTO, SIGNIFICATIVAMENTE MAIORES EM TERMOS DE GANHO DE PESO, GANHO DE PESO DIÁRIO, TAXA DE CRESCIMENTO ESPECÍFICO DO QUE NO GRUPO CONTROLE (P<0,05). NÃO HOUVE DIFERENÇA SIGNIFICATIVA ENTRE OS GRUPOS QUANTO AO FATOR DE CONDIÇÃO. A TEMPERATURA 42/4°C INDUZIU 35% DE NÚCLEOS TRIPLOIDES, ENQUANTO, A TEMPERATURA 40/4°C NÃO FOI EFETIVA PARA TRIPLOIDIZAÇÃO. DESTA FORMA, O GRUPO 42/4°C FOI O MELHOR TRATAMENTO QUE PRODUZIU LARVAS DE TAMBAQUI COM MAIOR PESO E COMPRIMENTO MÉDIO INICIAL QUANDO COMPARADOS À CONDIÇÃO A 40/4°C E SEM NENHUM TRATAMENTO TÉRMICO, ESTE MESMO DESEMPENHO MANTEVE-SE ATÉ AO FINAL DO ESTUDO TANTO QUANTO NA FASE DE JUVENIS. DS_ABSTRACT: IN ORDER TO EVALUATE THE EFFECT OF SHORT-TERM HEAT STRESS ON REPRODUCTIVE PERFORMANCE OF SAANEN GOATS SUBMITTED TO ESTRUS SYNCHRONIZATION AND ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATION IN THE SEMIARID OF BRAZILIAN NORTHEAST, 27 FEMALES WERE DISTRIBUTED INTO TWO GROUPS: SHADOW (N = 13) AND SUN (N = 14), WHERE ENVIRONMENTAL AND PHYSIOLOGICAL DATA WERE COLLECTED TWICE A WEEK AND TWICE A DAY. AIR TEMPERATURE (AT) AND RELATIVE HUMIDITY (RH) WERE OBTAINED USING A DIGITAL THERMOHYGROMETER TO CALCULATE THE TEMPERATURE AND HUMIDITY INDEX (ITH). TO MEASURE THE RECTAL TEMPERATURE (RT), A DIGITAL CLINICAL THERMOMETER WAS INTRODUCED INTO THE RECTUM OF THE ANIMAL; THE SURFACE TEMPERATURE (ST) WAS OBTAINED THROUGH AN INFRARED THERMOMETER WITH LASER SIGHT; THE RESPIRATORY RATE (RR) WAS MEASURED BY OBSERVING THE MOVEMENTS OF THE ANIMAL'S FLANK FOR 15 SECONDS; THE HEART RATE (HR) WAS MEASURED BY AUSCULTATION OF THE HEART RATE USING A STETHOSCOPE FOR 15 SECONDS. AFTER 44 DAYS OF THE START OF THE EXPERIMENT, THE ESTRUS WAS SYNCHRONIZED USING INTRAVAGINAL SPONGES (MAP) FOR 9 DAYS. AFTER 12 H OF SPONGE REMOVAL, THE GOATS WERE SUBMITTED TO ESTRUS DETECTION WITH THE USE OF ONE GOAT, EVERY 4 H. TRANSCERVICAL ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATIONS (AI) WERE PERFORMED 16 H AFTER OESTRUS ONSET WITH FRESH SEMEN, COLLECTED FROM SAANEN BUCK AND EXTENDED WITH POWDER COCONUT WATER EXTENSOR (ACP101®). THE PHYSIOLOGICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL PARAMETERS WERE ANALYZED BY THE ANOVA PROCEDURE IN A FACTORIAL SCHEME. THE MEANS BETWEEN THE TREATMENTS WERE COMPARED BY STUDENT'S T TEST. THE PERCENTAGES OF ANIMALS SHOWING ESTRUS WERE COMPARED BY THE CHI-SQUARE TEST. THE SAS UNIVERSITY PROGRAM WAS USED AND DIFFERENCES WERE CONSIDERED SIGNIFICANT WHEN P<0.05. THERE WERE SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCES (P<0.05) OF AT, RH, ITH, RT, RR, HR, ST, ITH WHEN COMPARING THE GROUPS (SHADOW AND SUN) AND THE INTERACTION BETWEEN OBSERVATION MOMENTS (9:00 A.M. AND 2:00 P.M.). AS FOR THE INTERVAL BETWEEN SPONGE REMOVAL AND ESTRUS ONSET, ESTRUS PERCENTAGE, ESTRUS LENGTH, TYPE OF AI AND PREGANCY RATE, NO SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE (P>0.05) WAS OBSERVED BETWEEN THE GROUPS (SHADOW AND SUN). SHORT-TERM HEAT STRESS AFFECTS PHYSIOLOGICAL RESPONSES BUT IT DOES NOT INFLUENCE THE REPRODUCTIVE PERFORMANCE OF SAANEN GOATS SUBMITTED TO ESTRUS SYNCHRONIZATION AND ARTIFICIAL INSEMINATION. KEY WORDS: BIOCLIMATOLOGY. GOAT. REPRODUCTION.

DS_ABSTRACT: THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS STUDY WAS TO EVALUATE THE CHEMICAL COMPOSITION, PHYSICAL AND SENSORIAL CHARACTERISTICS AND ANTIOXIDANT EFFECT OF MORINGA FLOUR IN GOAT MEAT HAMBURGERS. GOAT MEAT WAS OBTAINED FROM SAANEN GOATS SLAUGHTERED AT EIGHT MONTHS OF AGE ADDING MORINGA FLOUR AT LEVELS 0; 0.5; 1.0; 1.5; 2.0% AND ANTIOXIDANT BUTYL HYDROXYTOLUENE (BHT), CALCULATED UNDER THE WEIGHT OF THE MEAT MASS. IN THE BURGERS WERE EVALUATED THE PH, COLOR, WEIGHT LOSS TO COOKING, SHEAR FORCE, TEXTURE PROFILE, SHRINKAGE PERCENTAGE, YIELD, WATER RETENTION CAPACITY AND CENTESIMAL COMPOSITION. THE 2-THIOBARBITURIC ACID (TBARS) INDEX WAS DETERMINED TO EVALUATE THE LIPID OXIDATION OF STORED HAMBURGERS UNDER FREEZING OVER A PERIOD OF 0, 30, 60, 90 AND 120 DAYS. THERE WERE NO CHANGES IN THE PARAMETERS OF MOISTURE, ETHEREAL EXTRACT, CRUDE PROTEIN AND MINERAL MATTER OF THE HAMBURGERS WITH THE ADDITION OF MORINGA FLOUR. THE PH OF THE BURGERS RANGED FROM 6.14 TO 6.26. THE INCLUSION OF MORINGA FLOUR ALTERED THE COLOR OF BURGERS, RESULTING IN DARKER BURGERS, AFFECTING LUMINOSITY (L *) AND INTENSITIES OF RED (A *) AND YELLOW (B *). THE PERCENTAGE OF SHRINKAGE OF HAMBURGERS DIFFERED AMONG TREATMENTS, WITH LOWER VALUE (5,27%) IN HAMBURGERS MADE WITH 2% OF MORINGA FLOUR. THE SHEAR FORCE WAS SIMILAR FOR ALL TREATMENTS WITH A MEAN OF 1.86 KGF / CM2. IN THE ANALYZES WITH THE TEXTUROMETER, THE HAMBURGERS WITH HIGHER LEVELS OF MORINGA FLOUR, OBTAINED LOWER HARDNESS COMPARED TO THE HAMBURGERS OF THE CONTROL AND BHT TREATMENTS. IN THE SENSORIAL ANALYSIS IT WAS EVIDENCED THAT THE HIGHER LEVEL OF INCLUSION (2%) OF MORINGA FLOUR HAD LESS ACCEPTANCE AND ALSO LESS INTENTION TO BUY. THE ADDITION OF MORINGA FLOUR PROVIDED DARKER BURGERS, WITH NO EFFECT ON OXIDATIVE STABILITY, HOWEVER, IMPROVED THE HARDNESS, COHESION AND RESILIENCE CHARACTERISTICS OF HAMBURGERS WITH HIGHER LEVELS OF MORINGA FLOUR IN RELATION TO CONTROL AND BHT TREATMENTS. IT IS CONCLUDED THAT INCLUSION OF MORINGA FLOUR UP TO 1.5% IN THE GOAT BURGER DOES NOT AFFECT THE CHEMICAL, PHYSICAL AND SENSORIAL CHARACTERISTICS.

DS_RESUMO: OBJETIVOU-SE AVALIAR A COMPOSIÇÃO QUÍMICA, AS CARACTERÍSTICAS FÍSICAS E SENSORIAL E O EFEITO ANTIOXIDANTE DA FARINHA DE MORINGA EM HAMBÚRGUERES DE CARNE CAPRINA. A CARNE CAPRINA FOI OBTIDA DE CABRITOS DA RAÇA SAANEN ABATIDOS AOS OITO MESES DE IDADE ADICIONANDOS FARINHA DE MORINGA NOS NÍVEIS 0; 0,5; 1,0; 1,5; 2,0% E ANTIOXIDANTE BUTIL-HIDROXITOLUENO (BHT), CALCULADA SOB O PESO DA MASSA CÁRNEA. NOS HAMBÚRGUERES FORAM AVALIADOS O PH, COR, PERDA DE PESO AO COZIMENTO (PPC), FORÇA DE CISALHAMENTO (FC), PERFIL DE TEXTURA, PERCENTUAL DE ENCOLHIMENTO (PE), RENDIMENTO, CAPACIDADE DE RETENÇÃO DE ÁGUA (CRA) E COMPOSIÇÃO CENTESIMAL. O ÍNDICE DE ÁCIDO 2-TIOBARBITÚRICO (TBARS) FOI DETERMINADO PARA AVALIAR A OXIDAÇÃO LIPÍDICA DOS HAMBÚRGUERES ARMAZENADOS SOB CONGELAMENTO DURANTE UM PERÍODO DE 0, 30, 60, 90 E 120 DIAS. NÃO HOUVE ALTERAÇÃO NOS PARÂMETROS DE UMIDADE, EXTRATO ETÉREO, PROTEÍNA BRUTA E MATÉRIA MINERAL DOS HAMBÚRGUERES COM ADIÇÃO DE FARINHA DE MORINGA. O PH DOS HAMBÚRGUERES VARIOU DE 6,14 A 6,26. A INCLUSÃO DE FARINHA DE MORINGA ALTEROU A COLORAÇÃO DOS HAMBÚRGUERES, RESULTANDO EM HAMBÚRGUERES MAIS ESCUROS, AFETANDO A LUMINOSIDADE (L*) E AS INTENSIDADES DE VERMELHO (A*) E AMARELO (B*). O PERCENTUAL DE ENCOLHIMENTO DOS HAMBÚRGUERES DIFERIU ENTRE OS TRATAMENTOS, COM MENOR VALOR (5,27%) NOS HAMBÚRGUERES ELABORADOS COM 2% DE FARINHA DE MORINGA. A FORÇA DE CISALHAMENTO FOI SEMELHANTE PARA TODOS OS TRATAMENTOS COM MÉDIA DE 1,86KGF/CM2. NAS ANALISES COM O TEXTURÔMETRO, OS HAMBURGUERES COM MAIORES NÍVEIS DE FARINHA DE MORINGA, OBTIVERAM MENOR DUREZA EM RELAÇÃO AOS HAMBÚRGUERES DOS TRATAMENTOS CONTROLE E BHT. NA ANALISE SENSORIAL EVIDENCIOU-SE QUE O MAIOR NÍVEL DE INCLUSÃO (2%) DE FARINHA DE MORINGA TEVE MENOR ACEITAÇÃO E TAMBÉM MENOR INTENÇÃO DE COMPRA. A ADIÇÃO DA FARINHA DE MORINGA PROPORCIONOU HAMBÚRGUERES MAIS ESCUROS, NÃO HAVENDO EFEITO SOBRE A ESTABILIDADE OXIDATIVA, NO ENTANTO, MELHORARAM AS CARACTERÍSTICAS DE DUREZA, COESÃO E RESILIÊNCIA DOS HAMBÚRGUERES COM MAIORES NÍVEIS DE FARINHA DE MORINGA EM RELAÇÃO AOS TRATAMENTOS CONTROLE E BHT. CONCLUI-SE QUE INCLUSÃO DA FARINHA DE MORINGA ATÉ 1,5% NO HAMBÚRGUER CAPRINO NÃO AFETA AS CARACTERÍSTICAS QUÍMICAS, FÍSICAS E SENSORIAIS.

DS_ABSTRACT: DUE TO THE EMPIRICAL HYPOTHESIS THAT THE FAVELEIRA (CNIDOSCOLUS QUERCIFOLIUS POHL) CAN INFLUENCE THE TASTE AND CHARACTERISTICS OF THE MEAT, AN EXPERIMENT WAS CARRIED OUT USING 32 DORPER LAMBS, WITH 4 TO 6 MONTHS OF AGE, WEIGHING 19 ± 0,35 KG, SUBMITTED TO DIETS WITH 0,0; 33,3; 66,6 AND 100% SUBSTITUTION OF BUFFEL GRASS HAY BY FAVELEIRA HAY, WITH VOLUMINOUS RATIO: CONCENTRATE OF 55:45. AFTER 76 DAYS OF CONFINEMENT, WITH AN AVERAGE BODY WEIGHT OF 30,95 KG, THE ANIMALS WERE SLAUGHTERED, OBTAINING EMPTY BODY AND COLD CARCASS WEIGHTS OF 26,28 AND 14,38 KG, RESPECTIVELY. SUBSEQUENTLY WE MEASURED THE MORPHOMETRIC MEASUREMENTS OF CARCASS, WEIGHT AND YIELD OF NON-CARCASS COMPONENTS AND COMMERCIAL CUTS, THE LONGISSIMUS DORSI MUSCLE WAS SEPARATED AND DISSECTED FOR PHYSICAL, CHEMICAL AND SENSORIAL ANALYZES. DATA WERE SUBMITTED TO ANALYSIS OF VARIANCE AND REGRESSION AND THE VARIABLES OF THE SENSORIAL ANALYSIS WERE SUBMITTED TO THE KRUSKAL-WALLIS TEST AND THE MANN-WHITNEY TEST. THE INTENTION TO PURCHASE WAS ASSESSED USING THE CHI-SQUARE TEST AND IN ALL CASES A SIGNIFICANT SIGNIFICANCE LEVEL OF 5% WAS CONSIDERED SIGNIFICANT. IN THE MORPHOMETRIC MEASUREMENTS, ONLY THE LEG LENGTH AND COMPACTNESS SHOWED A QUADRATIC EFFECT, WITH MAXIMUM VALUE EXPRESSED AS 65,08% OF FAVELEIRA HAY REPLACING THE BUFFEL GRASS HAY FOR THE LENGTH AND MINIMUM VALUE AT 35,33% FOR THE LEG COMPACTNESS INDEX. IN THE PHYSICAL AND CHEMICAL ANALYSIS OF THE MEAT, NO INFLUENCE OF FEED (P> 0,05) WAS OBSERVED FOR THE PARAMETERS OF LOSS OF COOKING (31,75%), SHEAR FORCE (4.89KGF / CM²), WATER HOLDING CAPACITY (70%), MOISTURE (76,06%) PROTEIN (21,77%), ETHEREAL EXTRACT (2,25%) AND MINERAL MATTER (1,90%). IN RELATION TO THE FATTY ACID PROFILE, ONLY THE EICOSADIENOIC SHOWED A QUADRATIC EFFECT, WITH A MAXIMUM OF 68.32% OF FAVELEIRA HAY, BUT THE FEED DID NOT INFLUENCE THE SUMS AND PROPORTIONS OF SATURATED FATTY ACIDS, MONO- AND POLYUNSATURATED FATTY ACIDS, NOR THE NUTRACEUTICAL PARAMETERS. IN THE SENSORY EVALUATION, FLAVOR NOTES PRESENTED HIGHER VALUES FROM 66,6% OF FAVELEIRA IN THE DIET AND THE INTENTION OF PURCHASE WAS HIGHER (62,35%) FOR THE MEAT OF ANIMALS THAT RECEIVED 100% FAVELEIRA. FAVELEIRA HAY REPLACING BUFFEL GRASS HAY UP TO 62,08% INCREASES LEG LENGTH AND UP TO 68,8% IMPROVES MEAT QUALITY BY RAISING EICOSADIENOIC FATTY ACID LEVELS. HOWEVER, THE USE OF 100% OF FAVELEIRA HAY IN THE DIET OF LAMBS, IMPROVES THE FLAVOR OF THE MEAT AND POSITIVELY INFLUENCES THE INTENTION TO BUY.

DS_ABSTRACT: BOVINE MASTITIS IS A CONDITION THAT CAUSES DAMAGE TO THE ECONOMY OF BRAZIL. THE USE OF ANTIBIOTICS INDISCRIMINATELY CAN CAUSE RESISTANCE IN THE BACTERIA RELATED TO THIS INFECTION. THE OBJECTIVES OF THIS STUDY WERE TO CHARACTERIZE THE BLAZ, BLAR1 AND BLAI GENES AND THEIR RELATIONSHIP WITH BETA-LACTAM RESISTANCE IN STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS SAMPLES ISOLATED FROM BOVINE MASTITIS CASES. FOR THIS, POLYMERASE CHAIN REACTIONS WERE PERFORMED TO CONFIRM THE SPECIES AND TO VERIFY THE PRESENCE OF THE BLAZ GENE IN ISOLATES. BLAZ POSITIVE ISOLATES WERE ANALYZED FOR RESISTANCE / SENSITIVITY TO OXACILLIN BETA-LACTAM. BLAZ POSITIVE AND OXACILLIN RESISTANT ISOLATES AND BLAZ POSITIVE AND OXACILLIN SENSITIVE ISOLATES HAD THE BLAZ, BLAR1 AND BLAI GENES SEQUENCED. SEQUENCES WERE ANALYZED TO VERIFY THE PRESENCE OF POLYMORPHISMS WITH THE CLUSTALW PROGRAM. THEN, THE INFLUENCE OF POLYMORPHISMS ON THE FUNCTIONS OF PROTEINS CODED WITH THE PROVEAN PROGRAM WAS EVALUATED IN SILICO. THE PROTEINS WERE MODELED AND THEIR STRUCTURES EVALUATED WITH THE TM-ALIGN PROGRAM. SOME MUTATIONS FOUND IN THE GENES AND SAMPLES EVALUATED (BOTH SENSITIVE AND RESISTANT) WERE CLASSIFIED AS DELETERIOUS AND COULD LEAD TO CHANGES IN THE STRUCTURE OR FUNCTION OF THE ENCODED PROTEIN. ANALYZES INVOLVING MOLECULAR DOCKING AND GENE EXPRESSION MAY HELP TO UNDERSTAND THE RESISTANCE / SENSITIVITY PHENOMENON OF S. AUREUS POSITIVE BLAZ ISOLATES.

OS OBJETIVOS DESSE ESTUDO FORAM CARACTERIZAR OS GENES BLAZ, BLAR1 E BLAI E A RELAÇÃO DELES COM A RESISTÊNCIA A BETA-LACTÂMICOS EM AMOSTRAS DE STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS ISOLADAS DE CASOS DE MASTITE BOVINA. PARA ISSO, FORAM REALIZADAS REAÇÕES EM CADEIA DA POLIMERASE PARA CONFIRMAÇÃO DE ESPÉCIE E PARA VERIFICAR A PRESENÇA DO GENE BLAZ NO ISOLADOS. ISOLADOS POSITIVOS PARA O BLAZ E RESISTENTES À OXACILINA E ISOLADOS NEGATIVOS PARA O BLAZ E SENSÍVEIS À OXACILINA TIVERAM OS GENES BLAZ, BLAR1 E BLAI SEQUENCIADOS. OS SEQUENCIAMENTOS FORAM ANALISADOS PARA VERIFICAR A PRESENÇA DE POLIMORFISMOS COM O PROGRAMA CLUSTALW. EM SEGUIDA, FOI AVALIADO IN SILICO, A INFLUÊNCIA DOS POLIMORFISMOS SOBRE AS FUNÇÕES DAS PROTEÍNAS CODIFICADAS COM O PROGRAMA PROVEAN. AS PROTEÍNAS FORAM MODELADAS E SUAS ESTRUTURAS AVALIADAS COM O PROGRAMA TM-ALIGN. ALGUMAS MUTAÇÕES ENCONTRADAS NOS GENES E AMOSTRAS AVALIADAS (TANTO SENSÍVEL COMO RESISTENTE) FORAM CLASSIFICADAS COMO DELETÉRIAS E PODERIAM ACARRETAR ALTERAÇÕES NA ESTRUTURA OU FUNÇÃO DA PROTEÍNA CODIFICADA, NO ENTANTO, OS RESULTADOS DAS MODELAGENS INDICARAM QUE OS POLIMORFISMOS ENCONTRADOS NÃO PROVOCAM ALTERAÇÕES NA ESTRUTURA DAS PROTEÍNAS CODIFICADAS. ANÁLISES ENVOLVENDO DOCKING MOLECULAR E EXPRESSÃO GÊNICA PODERÃO AUXILIAR O ENTENDIMENTO DO FENÔMENO DE RESISTÊNCIA/SENSIBILIDADE DE ISOLADOS BLAZ POSITIVOS DE S. AUREUS.

NM_PROJETO: EFEITO DA KISSPEPTINA SOBRE PARÂMETROS PRODUTIVOS E REPRODUTIVOS DE CABRAS SAANEN EM LACTAÇÃO EXPLORADOS NO SEMIÁRIDO DO SUBMÉDIO DO SÃO FRANCISCO
DS_ABSTRACT: THE INCREASE IN MILK PRODUCTION AND THE MAINTENANCE OF ITS QUALITY ARE AMONG THE MAIN PERSPECTIVES OF DAIRY GOAT BREEDING. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS STUDY WAS TO EVALUATE THE EFFECT OF KISSPEPTIN (KP) AND RECOMBINANT BOVINE SOMATOTROPIN (R-BST) ON MILK PRODUCTION AND COMPOSITION OF SAANEN GOATS. THE RESEARCH WAS CONDUCTED IN THE CAPRINOCULTURA SECTOR, LOCATED IN THE AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES CAMPUS, FEDERAL UNIVERSITY OF THE SÃO FRANCISCO VALLEY. EIGHTEEN LACTATING GOATS WERE USED BETWEEN 60 AND 115 DAYS OF LACTATION, DISTRIBUTED IN A COMPLETELY RANDOMIZED DESIGN WITH THREE TREATMENTS AND SIX REPLICATES. THE EXPERIMENTAL GROUPS WERE: CONTROL (WITHOUT APPLICATION OF R-BST OR KP), R-BST (WITH SUBCUTANEOUS APPLICATION OF 250 MG R-BST EVERY 14 DAYS) AND KP (WITH DAILY INTRAVENOUS APPLICATIONS OF 10 NMOL KP / KG OF LIVE WEIGHT). THE ANIMALS RECEIVED THE SAME FEED WITH A BULKY: CONCENTRATE RATIO OF 60:40. IT WAS OFFERED CHOPPED AND CONCENTRATED ELEPHANTGRASS BASED ON MILLED CORN, SOYBEAN MEAL, LIMESTONE AND MINERAL MIX. THE VARIABLES WERE SUBMITTED TO ANALYSIS OF VARIANCE AND THE MEANS WERE COMPARED BY THE F TEST, WITH 5% PROBABILITY. THE PERSISTENCE OF MILK PRODUCTION WAS EVALUATED USING WOOD (1967) RANGE FUNCTION. THE R-BST PROMOTED AN INCREASE IN FEED INTAKE (P <0.05); WATER INTAKE, THERE WAS NO STATISTICAL DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE EXPERIMENTAL GROUPS (P> 0.05). THE R-BST PROMOTED INCREASED MILK PRODUCTION (P <0.05) AND PERSISTENCE OF LACTATION, WHILE KP PRESENTED A SIMILAR RESULT TO THE CONTROL GROUP. IN THE BLOOD PARAMETERS, IT WAS OBSERVED THAT, IN THE R-BST GROUP, THERE WAS A REDUCTION IN THE CONCENTRATIONS OF TOTAL PROTEIN, ALBUMIN AND TRIGLYCERIDES, BUT INCREASED GLUCOSE CONCENTRATIONS (P <0.05). IN THE KP GROUP, THERE WAS A REDUCTION IN ALBUMIN CONCENTRATIONS AND AN INCREASE IN GLOBULINS (P <0.05). REGARDING MILK CHARACTERISTICS, R-BST AND KP REDUCED FAT PERCENTAGE (P <0.05). IT IS CONCLUDED THAT THE ADMINISTRATION OF KP DOES NOT INCREASE MILK PRODUCTION, SINCE R-BST PROMOTES GREATER TARGETING OF NUTRIENTS AND METABOLITES FOR MILK SYNTHESIS, RESULTING IN INCREASED PRODUCTION.

DS_RESUMO: O AUMENTO DA PRODUÇÃO DE LEITE E A MANUTENÇÃO DA SUA QUALIDADE ESTÃO ENTRE AS PRINCIPAIS PERSPECTIVAS DA CAPRINOCULTURA LEITEIRA. OBJETIVOU-SE AVALIAR A KISSPEPTINA (KP) E SOMATOTROPINA BOVINA RECOMBINANTE (R-BST) NA PRODUÇÃO E COMPOSIÇÃO DO LEITE DE CABRAS SAANEN. A PESQUISA FOI CONDUZIDA NO SETOR DE CAPRINOCULTURA, LOCALIZADO NO CAMPUS CIÊNCIAS AGRÁRIAS, DA UNIVERSIDADE FEDERAL DO VALE DO SÃO FRANCISCO. FORAM UTILIZADAS 18 CABRAS LACTANTES ENTRE 60 E 115 DIAS DE LACTAÇÃO, DISTRIBUÍDAS EM UM DELINEAMENTO INTEIRAMENTE CASUALIZADO, COM TRÊS TRATAMENTOS E SEIS REPETIÇÕES. OS GRUPOS EXPERIMENTAIS FORAM: CONTROLE (SEM APLICAÇÃO DE R-BST OU KP), R-BST (COM APLICAÇÃO SUBCUTÂNEA DE 250 MG DE R-BST A CADA 14 DIAS) E KP (COM APLICAÇÕES INTRAVENOSA DIÁRIAS DE 10 NMOL DE KP/KG DE PESO VIVO). OS ANIMAIS RECEBERAM A MESMA ALIMENTAÇÃO COM RELAÇÃO VOLUMOSO:CONCENTRADO DE 60:40. FORAM OFERTADOS O CAPIM-ELEFANTE PICADO E CONCENTRADO A BASE DE MILHO MOÍDO, FARELO DE SOJA, CALCÁRIO E MISTURA MINERAL. AS VARIÁVEIS FORAM SUBMETIDAS À ANÁLISE DE VARIÂNCIA E AS MÉDIAS COMPARADAS PELO TESTE F, COM 5% DE PROBABILIDADE. A PERSISTÊNCIA DA PRODUÇÃO DE LEITE FOI AVALIADA USANDO A FUNÇÃO GAMA DE WOOD (1967). A R-BST PROMOVEU O AUMENTO DO CONSUMO DE RAÇÃO (P<0,05); QUANTO À INGESTÃO DE ÁGUA, NÃO HOUVE DIFERENÇA ESTATÍSTICA ENTRE OS GRUPOS EXPERIMENTAIS (P>0,05). A R-BST PROMOVEU O AUMENTO DA PRODUÇÃO DE LEITE (P<0,05) E DA PERSISTÊNCIA DA LACTAÇÃO, ENQUANTO A KP APRESENTOU RESULTADO SEMELHANTE AO GRUPO CONTROLE. NOS PARÂMETROS SANGUÍNEOS, OBSERVOU-SE QUE, NO GRUPO R-BST, HOUVE REDUÇÃO NAS CONCENTRAÇÕES DE PROTEÍNA TOTAL, ALBUMINA E TRIGLICERÍDEOS, PORÉM, AUMENTOU AS CONCENTRAÇÕES DE GLICOSE (P<0,05). JÁ NO GRUPO KP, OBSERVOU-SE REDUÇÃO NAS CONCENTRAÇÕES DE ALBUMINA E AUMENTO NAS DE GLOBULINAS (P<0,05). QUANTO ÀS CARACTERÍSTICAS DO LEITE OBSERVOU-SE QUE A R-BST E A KP REDUZEM A PORCENTAGEM DE GORDURA (P<0,05). CONCLUI-SE QUE A ADMINISTRAÇÃO DE KP NÃO AUMENTA A PRODUÇÃO DE LEITE, JÁ A R-BST PROMOVE MAIOR DIRECIONAMENTO DE NUTRIENTES E METABOLITOS PARA SÍNTESE DO LEITE, RESULTANDO EM AUMENTO DA PRODUÇÃO. DS_ABSTRACT: THE OBJECTIVE WAS TO EVALUATE THE FERMENTATION PROFILE AND NUTRITIONAL EVALUATION OF FORAGE PALM AND MANIOCOBA SILAGES FOR GOATS BY MEANS OF FERMENTATION CHARACTERIZATION STUDIES AND CHEMICAL COMPOSITION OF SILAGES, AS WELL AS THE EVALUATION OF WATER AND NUTRIENT EFFICIENCY. TWO EXPERIMENTAL TRIALS WERE CARRIED OUT. THE FIRST ONE CONSISTED OF THE MANUFACTURE OF SILAGES IN PVC PIPES, 10 CM IN DIAMETER AND 50 CM IN HEIGHT IN A FACTORIAL DESIGN COMPOSED OF 5 LEVELS OF MANIOCOBA IN PALM SILAGE (0%, 25 %, 50%, 75% AND 100%) IN 6 OPENING TIMES (1, 7, 15, 30, 60 AND 90 DAYS). THE SECOND TRIAL CONSISTED OF A CANINDÉ GOAT DIGESTIBILITY STUDY IN A COMPLETELY RANDOMIZED DESIGN, COMPOSED OF 4 LEVELS OF MANIOCOBA (25%, 50%, 75% AND 100%) WITH 6 REPLICATES. THE USE OF MANIOCOBA IN FORAGE PALM SILAGE PROMOTED IMPROVEMENT IN THE FERMENTATION CHARACTERISTICS OF THE SILAGE, WITH REDUCTIONS IN PH (Y = -0.0210X + 0.71) AND IN THE CONCENTRATION OF AMMONIACAL NITROGEN (Y = -0.0314X + 3, 77). THERE WAS ALSO A REDUCTION IN LACTIC ACID CONCENTRATION (Y = -0.0210X + 0.71). THE DRY MATTER (DM), CRUDE PROTEIN (CP), NEUTRAL DETERGENT FIBER (NDF), ACID DETERGENT FIBER (ADF), CELLULOSE (CEL), HEMICELLULOSE (HEM) ) AND LIGNIN (LIG). THERE WAS NO DIFFERENCE (P> 0.05) FOR DRY MATTER AND TOTAL CARBOHYDRATE INTAKE (TC), HOWEVER, AN INCREASE (P <0.05) WAS OBSERVED, WITH INCREASING LINEAR EFFECT FOR THE VARIABLES: OM INTAKE, CP , EE, NDF AND ADF. THERE WAS A REDUCTION IN THE CONSUMPTION OF MINERAL MATTER (MM) AND NON-FIBROUS CARBOHYDRATES (NFC). AS FOR WATER INTAKE, THE ANIMALS FED WITH SILAGE CONTAINING 25% MANIOCOBA PRESENTED LOWER FEED CONSUMPTION (P <0.05) AND HIGHER FEED INTAKE. THERE WAS ALSO HIGHER TOTAL WATER CONSUMPTION FOR ANIMALS FED WITH SILAGES CONTAINING 25 AND 50% MANIOCOBA, WHICH RESULTED IN HIGHER VALUES OF TOTAL WATER EXCRETION. THERE WAS NO DIFFERENCE (P> 0.05) IN RELATION TO THE WATER BALANCE. A HIGHER DRY MATTER DIGESTIBILITY COEFFICIENT (DMDC) (P <0.05) WAS VERIFIED FOR THE ANIMALS FED WITH THE SILAGE CONSTITUTED OF 25% MANIOCOBA. THE HIGHEST DIGESTIBILITY COEFFICIENT OF CP WAS OBTAINED BY THE ANIMALS THAT RECEIVED THE SILAGE COMPOSED ONLY OF MANIOCOBA (100%). THERE WAS NO DIFFERENCE (P> 0.05) FOR THE DIGESTIBILITY COEFFICIENT OF THE ETHEREAL EXTRACT (DCEE). REGARDING THE NITROGEN BALANCE, THIS WAS POSITIVE FOR ALL THE SILAGES EVALUATED. HOWEVER, A HIGHER NITROGEN RETENTION WAS OBSERVED IN THE ANIMALS FED WITH SILAGE (MANIOCOBA ONLY) (100%). THE INCLUSION OF MANIOCOBA IN PALM SILAGE PROMOTED IMPROVEMENTS IN FERMENTATIVE CHARACTERISTICS, NUTRITIONAL QUALITY, DIGESTIBILITY, AND ALSO INFLUENCED THE AMOUNT OF NITROGEN RETAINED IN THE ANIMAL ORGANISM. KEY WORDS: WATER SUPPLY, OPUNTIA, MANIHOT, CANINDÉ.

HOUVE REDUÇÃO NO CONSUMO DE MATÉRIA MINERAL (MM) E DE CARBOIDRATOS NÃO-FIBROSOS (CNF). QUANTO A INGESTÃO DE ÁGUA, OS ANIMAIS ALIMENTADOS COM SILAGEM CONTENDO 25% DE MANIÇOBA, APRESENTARAM MENOR CONSUMO VIA BEBEDOURO (P<0,05) E MAIOR CONSUMO VIA ALIMENTO. VERIFICOU-SE MAIOR COEFICIENTE DE DIGESTIBILIDADE DA MATÉRIA SECA (CDMS) (P<0,05) PARA OS ANIMAIS ALIMENTADOS COM A SILAGEM CONSTITUÍDA DE 25% MANIÇOBA. NÃO HOUVE DIFERENÇA (P>0,05) PARA O COEFICIENTE DE DIGESTIBILIDADE DO EXTRATO ETÉREO (CDEE). DS_ABSTRACT: SHEEP'S MILK PRODUCTION IS AN ANIMAL RAISING ALTERNATIVE FOR THE REGION OF THE SÃO FRANCISCO VALLEY IN PERNAMBUCO. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS STUDY WAS TO EVALUATE THE EFFECT OF DIETARY SUPPLEMENTATION WITH DIFFERENT ENERGY SOURCES, PROVIDED BEFORE THE BREEDING SEASON AND DURING THE LACTATION PERIOD ON THE ESTROUS RESPONSE, FOLLICULAR DEVELOPMENT, HORMONAL PROFILE, MILK PHYSICAL AND CHEMICAL COMPOSITION AND YIELD OF CROSSBRED SHEEP CHEESES OF THE LACAUNE X SANTA INÊS BREEDS. THE STUDY WAS CARRIED OUT AT THE EXPERIMENTAL STATION OF EMBRAPA SEMIÁRIDO, IN TWO EXPERIMENTAL STUDIES, USING 60 CROSSBRED EWES OF LACAUNE X SANTA INÊS BREEDS. IN EXPERIMENT 1 (N = 48), THE EFFECT OF ESTRUS SYNCHRONIZATION AND/OR SHORT-TERM SUPPLEMENTATION (9 DAYS) WITH DIFFERENT SOURCES OF ENERGY BEFORE THE MATING SEASON ON ESTRUS RESPONSE, FOLLICULAR DYNAMICS AND HORMONAL PROFILES WAS EVALUATED. IN THE EXPERIMENT 2 (N = 12), THE EFFECTS OF LONG-TERM SUPPLEMENTATION (63 DAYS) WITH DIFFERENT ENERGY SOURCES DURING THE LACTATION PERIOD ON THE PRODUCTION AND PHYSICAL-CHEMICAL COMPOSITION OF SHEEP'S MILK AND CHEESE YIELD WERE EVALUATED. THE TREATMENTS WERE ELABORATED TO CONTAIN THREE SOURCES OF ENERGY: GRAZING OF TIFTON 85 (PASTURE), CRUSHED CORN (CORN) AND COTTON SEED (COTTON). IN EXPERIMENT 1, IT WAS OBSERVED THAT THE PERCENTAGE OF ESTRUS EWES WAS LOWER IN THE PASTURE GROUP WHEN COMPARED TO THE OTHER TREATMENTS. ALTHOUGH THERE WAS NO SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE, IT WAS OBSERVED THAT THE GROUPS SYNCHRONIZED AND SUPPLEMENTED WITH CORN OR COTTON SEED INCREASED THE OVULATION RATE BY 37.8% TO 51.5% COMPARED TO THE GROUP THAT WAS SYNCHRONIZED EXCLUSIVELY. THE NUMBER OF PREOVULATORY FOLLICLES WAS LOWER IN THE PASTURE GROUP (16.7%) WHEN COMPARED TO SYNCHRONIZED (66.7%), MAIZE (83.3%) AND COTTON (91.0%). INSULIN AND IGF-1 CONCENTRATIONS WERE SIMILAR BETWEEN THE EXPERIMENTAL GROUPS. IN EXPERIMENT 2, THE RESULTS SHOWED THAT THERE WERE NO SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCES BETWEEN PASTURE, MAIZE AND COTTON GROUPS IN THE VARIABLES OF SHEEP'S MILK PRODUCTION, AND THE INITIAL AND FINAL BODY WEIGHT OF THE SHEEP. THERE WERE SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCES IN COMPONENTS OF SHEEP'S MILK (PROTEIN, NON-FAT SOLIDS, MINERAL AND FREEZING POINT), EXCEPT FOR FAT CONTENT. THE MILK IN COTTON GROUP PRESENTED BETTER CHEESE YIELD. THUS, SHORT-TERM (9-DAY) FEEDING SUPPLEMENTATION WITH CORN OR COTTONSEED, ASSOCIATED WITH ESTRUS SYNCHRONIZATION, HAS A POSITIVE INFLUENCE ON THE NUMBER OF FEMALES IN ESTRUS, FOLLICULAR DEVELOPMENT AND OVULATION RATE. ALTHOUGH LONG-TERM SUPPLEMENTATION DOES NOT PROMOTE INCREASED MILK PRODUCTION IN THE EVALUATED GROUPS, SUPPLEMENTATION WITH COTTON SEEDS PROMOTES AN INCREASE IN THE PHYSICAL-CHEMICAL COMPOSITION OF SHEEP'S MILK AND, CONSEQUENTLY, A HIGHER YIELD OF THE CHEESES PRODUCED.

DS_RESUMO: A OVINOCULTURA DE LEITE É UMA ALTERNATIVA PECUÁRIA PARA A REGIÃO DO VALE DO SÃO FRANCISCO EM PERNAMBUCO. OBJETIVOU-SE COM ESSE ESTUDO AVALIAR O EFEITO DA SUPLEMENTAÇÃO ALIMENTAR COM DIFERENTES FONTES DE ENERGIA, FORNECIDAS ANTES DA ESTAÇÃO DE MONTA E DURANTE O PERÍODO DE LACTAÇÃO SOBRE A RESPOSTA ESTRAL, O DESENVOLVIMENTO FOLICULAR, PERFIL HORMONAL, COMPOSIÇÃO FÍSICO-QUÍMICA DO LEITE E RENDIMENTO DE QUEIJOS DE OVELHAS MESTIÇAS DAS RAÇAS LACAUNE X SANTA INÊS. O ESTUDO FOI REALIZADO NA ESTAÇÃO EXPERIMENTAL DA EMBRAPA SEMIÁRIDO, EM DOIS TRABALHOS EXPERIMENTAIS, UTILIZANDO 60 OVELHAS MESTIÇAS DAS RAÇAS LACAUNE X SANTA INÊS. NO EXPERIMENTO 1 (N = 48), FOI AVALIADO O EFEITO DA SINCRONIZAÇÃO DO ESTRO E/OU DA SUPLEMENTAÇÃO DE CURTA DURAÇÃO (9 DIAS) COM DIFERENTES FONTES DE ENERGIA ANTES DA ESTAÇÃO DE MONTA SOBRE A RESPOSTA ESTRAL, DESENVOLVIMENTO FOLICULAR E PERFIS HORMONAIS. NO EXPERIMENTO 2 (N = 12), FORAM AVALIADOS OS EFEITOS DA SUPLEMENTAÇÃO DE LONGA DURAÇÃO (63 DIAS) COM DIFERENTES FONTES DE ENERGIA DURANTE O PERÍODO DE LACTAÇÃO SOBRE A PRODUÇÃO E COMPOSIÇÃO FÍSICO-QUÍMICA DO LEITE DE OVELHAS E RENDIMENTO DE QUEIJOS. OS TRATAMENTOS FORAM ELABORADOS PARA CONTER TRÊS FONTES DE ENERGIA: PASTAGEM DE CAPIM TIFTON 85 (PASTO), MILHO EM GRÃO TRITURADO (MILHO) E CAROÇO DE ALGODÃO (ALGODÃO). NO EXPERIMENTO 1, FOI OBSERVADO QUE A PORCENTAGEM DE OVELHAS EM ESTRO FOI INFERIOR NO GRUPO PASTO EM COMPARAÇÃO AOS DEMAIS TRATAMENTOS. EMBORA NÃO HAVENDO DIFERENÇA SIGNIFICATIVA, FOI OBSERVADO QUE OS GRUPOS SINCRONIZADOS E SUPLEMENTADOS COM MILHO OU CAROÇO DE ALGODÃO AUMENTARAM A TAXA DE OVULAÇÃO EM 37,8 A 51,5% EM COMPARAÇÃO AO GRUPO QUE FOI SINCRONIZADO EXCLUSIVAMENTE. O NÚMERO DE FOLÍCULOS PRÉ-OVULATÓRIOS FOI INFERIOR NO GRUPO PASTO (16,7%) E COMPARAÇÃO AO SINCRONIZADO (66,7%), MILHO (83,3%) E ALGODÃO (91,0%). AS CONCENTRAÇÕES DE INSULINA E IGF-1 FORAM SEMELHANTES ENTRE OS GRUPOS EXPERIMENTAIS. NO EXPERIMENTO 2, OS RESULTADOS DEMONSTRAM QUE NÃO HOUVE DIFERENÇAS SIGNIFICATIVAS ENTRE OS GRUPOS PASTO, MILHO E ALGODÃO NAS VARIÁVEIS DE PRODUÇÃO MÉDIA DO LEITE DE OVELHA E NO PESO CORPORAL INICIAL E FINAL DAS OVELHAS. FORAM OBSERVADAS DIFERENÇAS SIGNIFICATIVAS EM COMPONENTES DO LEITE DE OVELHA (PROTEÍNA, SÓLIDOS NÃO GORDUROSOS, SAIS MINERAIS E PONTO DE CONGELAMENTO), EXCETO NO TEOR DE GORDURA. O LEITE DOS ANIMAIS DO GRUPO ALGODÃO APRESENTOU MELHOR RENDIMENTO DE QUEIJO. COM ISSO, CONCLUI-SE QUE A SUPLEMENTAÇÃO ALIMENTAR DE CURTA DURAÇÃO (9 DIAS) COM MILHO OU CAROÇO DE ALGODÃO, ASSOCIADA À SINCRONIZAÇÃO DO ESTRO, INFLUENCIA POSITIVAMENTE NO NÚMERO DE FÊMEAS EM ESTRO, NO DESENVOLVIMENTO FOLICULAR E NA TAXA DE OVULAÇÃO. APESAR DA SUPLEMENTAÇÃO DE LONGA DURAÇÃO NÃO PROMOVER AUMENTO NA PRODUÇÃO DE LEITE DOS GRUPOS AVALIADOS, A SUPLEMENTAÇÃO COM CAROÇO DE ALGODÃO PROMOVE AUMENTO DA COMPOSIÇÃO FÍSICO-QUÍMICA DO LEITE DE OVELHAS E, CONSEQUENTEMENTE, MAIOR RENDIMENTO DOS QUEIJOS PRODUZIDOS.

DS_ABSTRACT: THE CONSUMPTION OF PROBIOTICS, PREBIOTICS AND SYMBIOTICS HAS A HIGH DEMAND IN AQUACULTURE, CONFERRING HEALTH BENEFITS. THE FLOUR DERIVED FROM CASSAVA (MANIHOT ESCOLENTA CRAZ), AS A FUNCTIONAL FOOD ASSOCIATED WITH LACTOBACILLUS SPP., FORMING A SYMBIOTIC IN FISH FEEDING, IS AN ALTERNATIVE FOR AQUACULTURE. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS STUDY WAS TO EVALUATE THE EFFECT OF THE INCLUSION OF LACTOBACILLUS SPP. WITH THE FLOUR, ENCAPSULATED WITH SODIUM ALGINATE, AS FUNCTIONAL FOOD ADDED IN THE NILE TILAPIA RATION CHALLENGED WITH AEROMONAS SPP. THE CHARACTERIZATION OF THE FLOUR, ANTAGONISTIC ACTIVITY OF LACTOBACILLUS AGAINST AEROMONAS, IN VITRO TESTS WAS PERFORMED TO EVALUATE THE PREBIOTIC SOURCE IN INCREASING DOSES (2%, 4%, 6% AND 8%) WITH ADDITION OF LACTOBACILLUS SPP., AND THE IN ALIVE AFTER 30 DAYS OF EXPERIMENT, 2 OF THE 7 FISH OF EACH TREATMENT WERE EUTHANIZED AND WEIGHED FOR DETERMINATION OF ZOOTECHNICAL PARAMETERS, HEMATOLOGICAL VARIABLES AND SOME IMMUNE PARAMETERS. THE OTHERS WERE INOCULATED WITH AEROMONAS HYIDROPHILA, TO VERIFY THE SURVIVAL RATE. A COMPLETELY RANDOMIZED DESIGN WITH SEVEN TREATMENTS, T1 PURE RATION (R), T2 RATION WITH 8% FLOUR, LACTIC ACID BACTERIA (BAL) AND ALGINATE (RFAB), T3 RATION WITH ALGINATE (RA), T4 RATION WITH ALGINATE AND BAL (RAB), T5 RATION WITH BAL (RB), T6 RATION WITH FLOUR AND ALGINATE (RFA) AND T7 RATION WITH FLOUR (RF), EACH WITH 4 REPLICATES, TOTALING 196 ANIMALS. THE VALUES OF THE FLOUR CHARACTERIZATION ARE WITHIN THE NORMAL RANGE FOUND BY OTHER AUTHORS, WITH RESPECT TO CRUDE FIBER (FB) 1,59%, TOTAL PROTEIN (PT) 1,80% AND MOSSOCARÍDEOS 56,0. 14 ISOLATES OF THE 48 PRESENTED MICROBIAL ACTIVITY OF THE TEST OF ANTAGONISM, BEING SELECTED TO LAC 7 AND LAC 32 BECAUSE THEY HAVE THE BEST HALOS OF INHIBITION. AT THE CONCENTRATION OF THE FLOUR AT LAC 32 OBTAINED BETTER GROWTH COMPARED TO LAC 7. THE GROWTH KINETICS OF LAC 32 OBTAINED BETTER RESULT IN THE CONCENTRATION OF 8%, HAVING SATISFACTORY PEAK AFTER 12 H OF INCUBATION. THE ALGINATE SHOWED EFFICIENCY IN THE ENCAPSULATION AND MAINTENANCE OF THE SYMBIOTIC VIABILITY UP TO 10 DAYS AFTER ITS PREPARATION. IN THE AVERAGE DAILY GAIN (ADG) THE FINGERLINGS OBTAINED A STATISTICAL DIFFERENCE IN THE TREATMENTS USING THE SYMBIOTIC AND LACTOBACILLUS SPP. RATIONS, COMPARED TO THE RATION WITH CASSAVA FLOUR OBTAINING THE LOWEST GAIN. NO SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE WAS OBSERVED IN THE MORTALITY RATE BETWEEN TREATMENTS. HEMOGLOBIN (HB), HEMATOCRIT (PTH), PT, ALBUMIN, LYSOZYME, MEAN CORPUSCULAR HEMOGLOBIN (HCM) AND MEAN CORPUSCULAR HEMOGLOBIN CONCENTRATION (CHCM) SHOWED NO SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE, HOWEVER, ERYTHROCYTES, GLUCOSE AND MEAN CORPUSCULAR VOLUME VCM) SHOWED A SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE BETWEEN TREATMENTS, ALGINATE RATION AND CASSAVA MEAL, IN RELATION TO PURE RATION. IT IS CONCLUDED THAT THE GENUS LACTOBACILLUS HAS GOOD ANTAGONISTIC POTENTIAL AGAINST AEROMONASSPP. CASSAVA FLOUR IS AN ALTERNATIVE AS A PREBIOTIC SOURCE, HAVING THE MAXIMUM GROWTH OF LACTOBACILLUS SPP. WITH A CONCENTRATION OF 8%. THE ALGINATE PRESERVED THE VIABILITY OF THE MICROBIAL CELLS WITH THE JUNCTION OF THE FLOUR. SUPPLEMENTATION OF LACTOBACILLUS SPP. WITH FLOUR, EMPLOYED IN THE NILE TILAPIA DIET IMPROVED GMD, FINAL BIOMASS, FISH FEED CONVERSION AND SURVIVAL DURING THE EXPERIMENTAL PERIOD AND INFLUENCED THE ERYTHROCYTE, MCV AND GLUCOSE VALUES.

DS_ABSTRACT: THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS EXPERIMENT WAS TO EVALUATE THE POTENTIAL OF INCLUSION OF GLIRICIDIA, MORINGA AND PORCUPINE HAY AS SOURCES OF CRUDE PROTEIN IN FORAGE SORGHUM REGROWTH ENSILING. AN EXPERIMENT WAS CARRIED OUT IN A COMPLETELY RANDOMIZED DESIGN WITH FOUR TREATMENTS (SORGHUM SILAGE; SORGHUM SILAGE + GLIRICIDIA HAY; SORGHUM SILAGE + MORINGA HAY; SORGHUM SILAGE + PORNUNCIA HAY) IN FIVE REPLICATIONS. AFTER 75 DAYS OF SILOS CLOSING, LOSSES IN THE FORM OF GASES, TOTAL LOSS, DRY MATTER RECOVERY AND EFFLUENT PRODUCTION WERE DETERMINED. THE SILOS WERE THEN OPENED AND THE AQUEOUS EXTRACT OF THE SILAGES WAS OBTAINED IN ORDER TO DETERMINE THE CONTENTS OF THE ORGANIC ACIDS (ACETIC, BUTYRIC, LACTIC AND PROPIONIC), AND PH VALUES. THE SILAGE SAMPLES WERE ANALYZED FOR THEIR CHEMICAL-BROMATOLOGICAL COMPOSITION, GAS PRODUCTION IN VITRO BY THE CUMULATIVE GAS TECHNIQUE AND DETERMINATION OF RUMINAL DEGRADABILITY PARAMETERS. THE DATA OF THE EXPERIMENTAL TESTS WERE SUBMITTED TO THE F TEST OF THE ANALYSIS OF VARIANCE AT 5% OF PROBABILITY AND WHEN THEY DIFFERED SIGNIFICANTLY, THE MEANS COMPARED BY THE TUKEY TEST AT THE 5% PROBABILITY LEVEL. WITH THE INCLUSION OF THE HAY, A REDUCTION WAS OBSERVED IN GAS LOSSES, IN THE PRODUCTION OF EFFLUENT IN THE TOTAL LOSS OF DRY MATTER AND A HIGHER RECOVERY OF DRY MATTER (DM). IN THE TREATMENTS WHERE HAY WAS INCLUDED, THERE WAS A CONSIDERABLE DECREASE IN EFFLUENT LOSSES, APPROXIMATELY 79%, IN RELATION TO THE EXCLUSIVE SILAGE OF SORGHUM, AND TREATMENTS WITH THE INCLUSION OF GLIRICID AND MORINGA HAY PRESENTED THE HIGHEST RECOVERY VALUES OF MATTER DRY, BEING 97.31% AND 97.46%, RESPECTIVELY. THERE WAS A SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE (P <0.05) FOR THE PH VALUE AND ALL EVALUATED ORGANIC ACIDS (LACTIC, ACETIC, PROPIONIC AND BUTYRIC), SO THAT THE PH OF THE SILAGES WITH INCLUSION OF THE HAYS ARE WITHIN THAT EXPECTED FOR A SILAGE OF IT IS WORTH NOTING THAT ONLY TREATMENTS WITH EXCLUSIVE SORGHUM SILAGE AND THE INCLUSION OF MORINGA HAY PRESENTED SATISFACTORY LEVELS OF LACTIC ACID (4.27% AND 2.70%, RESPECTIVELY). THE TREATMENT WITH SORGHUM EXCLUSIVE SILAGE SHOWED THE HIGHEST GAS PRODUCTION AS A FUNCTION OF TOTAL CARBOHYDRATES (81.86 ML / G DM) AND SILAGES WITH THE INCLUSION OF MORINGA (64.29 AND 65.68 ML / G MS, RESPECTIVELY). A SIMILAR EFFECT WAS OBSERVED FOR THE POTENTIAL DEGRADABILITY VARIABLE, SO THAT WITH THE INCLUSION OF MORINGA HAY THERE WAS NO SIGNIFICANT DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE TREATMENTS STUDIED (P> 0.05), WITH THE HIGHEST VALUES OBSERVED (78.41 AND 78.70 MS%). WITH THE INCLUSION OF MORINGA HAY, THE HIGHEST VALUE OF EFFECTIVE DEGRADABILITY WAS ALSO OBSERVED (34.49). THE INCLUSION OF MORINGA HAY GENERATED A PROTEIN INCREASE OF 69.55% IN RELATION TO THE TREATMENT WITH EXCLUSIVE SILAGE OF SORGHUM, IMPROVEMENT IN NUTRITIVE VALUE AND EFFECTIVE DEGRADATION. IN THIS WAY, THE MORINGA HAY CAN BE INDICATED AS AN ADDITIVE ALTERNATIVE IN SORGHUM REGROWTH SILAGE.

DS_RESUMO: OBJETIVOU-SE COM O PRESENTE EXPERIMENTO AVALIAR O POTENCIAL DE INCLUSÃO DOS FENOS DE GLIRICÍDIA, MORINGA E PORNUNCIA COMO FONTES DE PROTEÍNA BRUTA NA ENSILAGEM DA REBROTA DO SORGO FORRAGEIRO. FOI ELABORADO UM EXPERIMENTO EM DELINEAMENTO INTEIRAMENTE CASUALIZADO COM QUATRO TRATAMENTOS (SILAGEM DE SORGO; SILAGEM DE SORGO + FENO DE GLIRICÍDIA; SILAGEM DE SORGO + FENO DE MORINGA; SILAGEM DE SORGO + FENO DE PORNUNCIA) EM CINCO REPETIÇÕES. APÓS 75 DIAS DO FECHAMENTO DOS SILOS, FORAM DETERMINADAS AS PERDAS NA FORMA DE GASES, PERDA TOTAL, RECUPERAÇÃO DE MATÉRIA SECA E PRODUÇÃO DE EFLUENTES. OS SILOS ENTÃO FORAM ABERTOS E OBTIDO O EXTRATO AQUOSO DAS SILAGENS, A FIM DE DETERMINAR OS TEORES DOS ÁCIDOS ORGÂNICOS (ACÉTICO, BUTÍRICO, LÁTICO E PROPIÔNICO), E VALORES DE PH. AS AMOSTRAS DAS SILAGENS FORAM ANALISADAS QUANTO A SUA COMPOSIÇÃO QUÍMICO-BROMATOLÓGICA, PRODUÇÃO DE GASES IN VITRO PELA TÉCNICA CUMULATIVA DE GASES E DETERMINAÇÃO DOS PARÂMETROS DE DEGRADABILIDADE RUMINAL. OS DADOS DOS ENSAIOS EXPERIMENTAIS FORAM SUBMETIDOS AO TESTE F DA ANÁLISE DE VARIÂNCIA A 5% DE PROBABILIDADE E QUANDO DIFERIRAM ENTRE SI SIGNIFICATIVAMENTE, AS MÉDIAS COMPARADAS PELO TESTE DE MÉDIA DE TUKEY AO NÍVEL DE 5% DE PROBABILIDADE. COM A INCLUSÃO DOS FENOS OBSERVOU-SE REDUÇÃO NAS PERDAS POR GASES, NA PRODUÇÃO DE EFLUENTE NA PERDA TOTAL DE MATÉRIA SECA E UMA MAIOR RECUPERAÇÃO DE MATÉRIA SECA (MS). NOS TRATAMENTOS ONDE HOUVE A INCLUSÃO DOS FENOS OBSERVOU-SE DIMINUIÇÃO CONSIDERÁVEL NAS PERDAS POR EFLUENTES, APROXIMADAMENTE 79%, EM RELAÇÃO À SILAGEM EXCLUSIVA DE SORGO SENDO QUE OS TRATAMENTOS COM A INCLUSÃO DE FENO DE GLIRICÍDIA E MORINGA APRESENTARAM OS MAIORES VALORES DE RECUPERAÇÃO DE MATÉRIA SECA, SENDO 97,31% E 97,46%, RESPECTIVAMENTE. HOUVE DIFERENÇA SIGNIFICATIVA (P<0,05) PARA O VALOR DE PH E TODOS OS ÁCIDOS ORGÂNICOS AVALIADOS (LÁTICO, ACÉTICO, PROPIÔNICO E BUTIRICO), DE MODO QUE O PH DAS SILAGENS COM INCLUSÃO DOS FENOS ESTÃO DENTRO DO ESPERADO PARA UMA SILAGEM DE QUALIDADE, MERECENDO DESTAQUE TAMBÉM QUE APENAS OS TRATAMENTOS COM SILAGEM EXCLUSIVA DE SORGO E O COM INCLUSÃO DO FENO DE MORINGA APRESENTARAM TEORES DE ÁCIDOS LÁTICO SATISFATÓRIOS (4,27% E 2,70%, RESPECTIVAMENTE). O TRATAMENTO COM SILAGEM EXCLUSIVA DE SORGO APRESENTOU A MAIOR PRODUÇÃO DE GASES EM FUNÇÃO DOS CARBOIDRATOS TOTAIS (81,86 ML/G MS) E AS SILAGENS COM A INCLUSÃO DE MORINGA AS MENORES (64,29 E 65,68 ML/G MS, RESPECTIVAMENTE). EFEITO SEMELHANTE OBSERVOU-SE PARA A VARIÁVEL DEGRADABILIDADE POTENCIAL, DE FORMA QUE COM A INCLUSÃO DE FENO DE MORINGA NÃO HOUVE DIFERENÇA SIGNIFICATIVA ENTRE OS TRATAMENTOS ESTUDADOS (P>0,05), SENDO OS MAIORES VALORES OBSERVADOS (78,41 E 78,70 %MS). COM A INCLUSÃO DO FENO DE MORINGA OBSERVOU-SE TAMBÉM O MAIOR VALOR DE DEGRADABILIDADE EFETIVA (34,49). A INCLUSÃO DO FENO DE MORINGA GEROU INCREMENTO PROTEICO DE 69,55% EM RELAÇÃO AO TRATAMENTO COM SILAGEM EXCLUSIVA DE SORGO, MELHORIA NO VALOR NUTRITIVO E DEGRADAÇÃO EFETIVA. PODENDO, DESSA FORMA, O FENO DA MORINGA SER INDICADO COMO ALTERNATIVA DE ADITIVO NA SILAGEM DA REBROTA DE SORGO.

NM_PROJETO: AÇÕES INTEGRADAS PARA A PRODUÇÃO E DESENVOLVIMENTO DE PRODUTOS LÁCTEOS DE LEITE CAPRINO EM REGIÕES ÁRIDAS E SEMIÁRIDAS DO NORDESTE BRASILEIRO E CENTRO SUL DO PERU.
DS_ABSTRACT: THE PRESENT WORK HAD AS OBJECTIVE TO EVALUATE THE EFFECT OF DIETS CONTAINING CUNHÃ AND FORAGE PALM AT THE FINISHING OF CROSSBRED GOATS. THIRTY-TWO MALE, UNCASTRATED, CROSSBRED (BOER) MALES, WITH A MEAN AGE OF 6 ± 2 MONTHS AND MEAN INITIAL WEIGHT OF 15.0 ± 0.6 KG WERE USED. THE EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOL FOLLOWED RANDOMIZIDE BLOCK DESIGN (RBD), WITH INITIAL BODY WEIGHT BEING A BLOCK FACTOR. FOUR EXPERIMENTAL DIETS AND EIGHT REPLICATES WERE USED. THESE DIETS WERE CHARACTERIZED BY THE ADDITION OF 83% FC + 17% PF (83/17), WITH 67% FC + 33% FP (67/33) AND WITH 50% FC + 50% FP (50/50). THESE PERCENTAGES REPRESENTED 60% DM OF THE TOTAL DIET. THE REMAINING 40% WERE COMPOSED OF 10% ELEPHANT GRASS (IN NATURA) AND 30% DRY MATTER CONCENTRATE (DM). THE CONTROL DIET WAS CHARACTERIZED BY 70% ELEPHANT GRASS (IN NATURA) AND 30% CONCENTRATE IN DM. THE CONCENTRATE WAS COMPOSED OF SOYBEAN MEAL, CORN AND UREA. THE NUTRIENT INTAKE, DIGESTIBILITY, WATER CONSUMPTION, INGESTIVE AND PHYSIOLOGICAL BEHAVIOR AND PERFORMANCE OF THE ANIMALS WERE EVALUATED. THERE WAS NO DIFFERENCE (P >0.05) BETWEEN THE EXPERIMENTAL DIETS FOR DRY MATTER (DMI), ORGANIC MATTER (OMI), MINERAL MATTER (MMI) AND CRUDE PROTEIN (CPI), INTAKE WITH A MEAN OF 0.629; 0.566; 0.059 AND 0.108 IN KG / DAY, RESPECTIVELY. INTAKE OF NEUTRAL DETERGENT FIBER (NDFI), ACID DETERGENT FIBER (ADFI) AND HEMICELLULOSE (HEMI) SHOWED DIFFERENCES BETWEEN TREATMENTS (P <0.05). THE COEFFICIENTS OF DRY MATTER DIGESTIBILITY (DMD), ORGANIC MATTER (OMD) AND NEUTRAL DETERGENT FIBER (NDFD) PRESENTED DIFFERENCES (P <0.05). THE CONTROL HAD THE HIGHEST WATER CONSUMPTION OF THE FOOD (P <0.05) WHEN COMPARED TO TREATMENTS 83/17, 67/33 AND 50/50. THE RUMINATION PERIOD WAS LOWER (P <0.05) FOR THE 50/50 TREATMENT, PRESENTING DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE OTHER TREATMENTS. IDLING TIME WAS HIGHER (P <0.05) FOR 50/50 TREATMENT WHEN COMPARED TO CONTROL AND TREATMENT 83/17, BUT DID NOT SHOW DIFFERENCE IN TREATMENT 67/33. THE 83/17 TREATMENT HAD A HIGHER RECTAL TEMPERATURE WHEN COMPARED TO THE CONTROL (P <0.05). THE DAILY AND TOTAL WEIGHT GAIN WERE HIGHER FOR THE 67/33 TREATMENT COMPARED TO THE CONTROL, BUT IT WAS NOT DIFFERENT FROM THE 83/17 AND 50/50 TREATMENTS. FEED CONVERSION WAS LOWER FOR CONTROL WHEN COMPARED TO TREATMENTS 83/17 AND 67/33, HOWEVER IT WAS NOT DIFFERENT FROM 50/50 TREATMENT. THE PROPORTION WITH 67% OF HAY AND 33% OF FODDER PALM HAY INCREASED THE DIGESTIBILITY AND WEIGHT GAIN WHEN COMPARED TO ELEPHANT GRASS (IN NATURA), WITHOUT CHANGING NUTRIENT AND WATER INTAKE OF BOER CROSSBREED GOATS AT FINISHING PHASE.

DS_RESUMO: O PRESENTE TRABALHO TEVE COMO OBJETIVO AVALIAR O EFEITO DE DIETAS CONTENDO FENOS DE CUNHÃ E PALMA FORRAGEIRA NA TERMINAÇÃO DE CAPRINOS MESTIÇOS BOER. FORAM UTILIZADOS 32 CABRITOS MACHOS NÃO CASTRADOS, MESTIÇOS (BOER), COM IDADE MÉDIA DE 6 ± 2 MESES E PESO INICIAL MÉDIO DE 15,0 ± 0,6 KG. O DELINEAMENTO EXPERIMENTAL UTILIZADO FOI O DE BLOCOS AO ACASO (DBC), SENDO O PESO CORPORAL INICIAL FATOR DOS BLOCOS. FORAM UTILIZADAS QUATRO DIETAS EXPERIMENTAIS E OITO REPETIÇÕES. ESTAS DIETAS FORAM DIFERENCIADAS PELAS PROPORÇÕES DOS FENOS DE CUNHÃ (FC) E PALMA FORRAGEIRA (FP), SENDO CARACTERIZADAS PELA ADIÇÃO DE 83% DE FC + 17% DE FP (83/17), COM 67% DE FC + 33% DE FP (67/33) E COM ADIÇÃO DE 50% DE FC + 50% DE FP (50/50). ESTAS PORCENTAGENS REPRESENTARAM 60% MS DA DIETA TOTAL. OS 40% RESTANTES FORAM COMPOSTOS POR 10% DE CAPIM ELEFANTE (IN NATURA) E 30% DE CONCENTRADO NA MATÉRIA SECA (MS). A DIETA CONTROLE FOI CARACTERIZADA POR 70% DE CAPIM ELEFANTE (IN NATURA) E 30% DE CONCENTRADO NA MS. O CONCENTRADO FOI COMPOSTO POR FARELO DE SOJA, MILHO E URÉIA. FORAM AVALIADOS OS CONSUMOS DOS NUTRIENTES, DIGESTIBILIDADE, CONSUMO DE ÁGUA, COMPORTAMENTO INGESTIVO E FISIOLÓGICO E DESEMPENHO DOS ANIMAIS. NÃO HOUVE DIFERENÇA (P>0,05) ENTRE AS DIETAS EXPERIMENTAIS PARA OS CONSUMOS DE MATÉRIA SECA (CMS), MATÉRIA ORGÂNICA (CMO), MATÉRIA MINERAL (CMM) E PROTEÍNA BRUTA (CPB), QUE APRESENTARAM MÉDIAS DE 0,629; 0,566; 0,059 E 0,108 EM KG/DIA, RESPECTIVAMENTE. OS CONSUMOS DE FIBRA EM DETERGENTE NEUTRO (CFDN), FIBRA EM DETERGENTE ÁCIDO (CFDA) E HEMICELULOSE (CHEM) APRESENTARAM DIFERENÇA ENTRE OS TRATAMENTOS (P<0,05). OS COEFICIENTES DE DIGESTIBILIDADE DA MATÉRIA SECA (CDMS), MATÉRIA ORGÂNICA (CDMO) E FIBRA EM DETERGENTE NEUTRO (CDFDN) APRESENTARAM DIFERENÇAS (P<0,05). O CONTROLE OBTEVE O MAIOR CONSUMO DE ÁGUA DO ALIMENTO (P<0,05) QUANDO COMPARADO COM OS TRATAMENTOS 83/17, 67/33 E 50/50. O PERÍODO DE RUMINAÇÃO FOI MENOR (P<0,05) PARA O TRATAMENTO 50/50, APRESENTANDO DIFERENÇA ENTRE OS DEMAIS TRATAMENTOS. O TEMPO EM ÓCIO FOI MAIOR (P<0,05) PARA O TRATAMENTO 50/50 QUANDO COMPARADO COM O CONTROLE E O TRATAMENTO 83/17, MAS NÃO APRESENTOU DIFERENÇA DO TRATAMENTO 67/33. O TRATAMENTO 83/17 OBTEVE MAIOR TEMPERATURA RETAL QUANDO COMPARADO COM O CONTROLE (P<0,05). O GANHO DE PESO DIÁRIO E O TOTAL FORAM MAIORES PARA O TRATAMENTO 67/33 EM COMPARAÇÃO AO CONTROLE, MAS NÃO FOI DIFERENTE DOS TRATAMENTOS 83/17 E 50/50. A CONVERSÃO ALIMENTAR FOI MAIOR PARA O CONTROLE QUANDO COMPARADO COM OS TRATAMENTOS 83/17 E 67/33, ENTRETANTO NÃO FOI DIFERENTE DO TRATAMENTO 50/50. A PROPORÇÃO COM 67% DE FENO DE CUNHÃ E 33% DE FENO DE PALMA FORRAGEIRA AUMENTAM A DIGESTIBILIDADE E GANHO DE PESO QUANDO COMPARADO COM O CAPIM ELEFANTE (IN NATURA), NÃO ALTERANDO OS CONSUMOS DE NUTRIENTES E DE ÁGUA NA FASE DE TERMINAÇÃO DE CABRITOS MESTIÇOS BOER.

NM_PROJETO: CONTROLE GERENCIAL, FINANCIAMENTO E INOVAÇÃO: MAPEAMENTO DE PRÁTICAS E ANÁLISE DAS TENSÕES DINÂMICAS
DS_ABSTRACT: THE DEVELOPMENT AND UNDERSTANDING OF COACHING ARE FUNDAMENTAL IN A PERIOD OF COMPETITIVENESS. FOR THIS, IT IS NECESSARY TO ALIGN THE NECESSARY COMPETENCIES TO FACILITATE THE WORK OF THE COACHES, USING SPECIFIC TECHNIQUES AND AUTONOMOUS TOOLS TO IMPROVE THE PERFORMANCE OF THE PROCESS. AS A RESULT OF THIS INVESTIGATION, WE SOUGHT TO VERIFY HOW THE COACHING PROCESS HAPPENS, WHICH ARE THE ACTORS INVOLVED, WHAT ARE THE AREAS OF COACHING AND THE CREDIBILITY OF THE SERVICE PROVIDER, CONSIDERING THAT COACHING IS NOT SIMPLY A TECHNIQUE TO BE APPLIED IN A PARTICULAR SITUATION BUT RATHER A WAY OF MONITORING PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL GOALS OF ITS CLIENTS, SEEKING THE HIGH PERFORMANCE. IN THIS SENSE, THIS WORK SOUGHT TO STRUCTURE A SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT PROCESS TO SUPPORT THE COACH'S PERFORMANCE. FOR THIS, THE COACHING BUSINESS MODEL WAS ANALYSED CONSIDERING THE BUSINESS MODEL CANVAS METHODOLOGY. AS A RESULT, THE MAIN FUNCTIONALITIES FOR SOFTWARE CREATION AND MONETIZATION MODELS WERE IDENTIFIED, AS WELL AS THE GAPS IN THE COACHING PROCESS. THE PROPOSED FUNCTIONALITIES FOR THE SOFTWARE TO BE DEVELOPED WILL ENABLE GROWTH FOR ALL INVOLVED.

DS_RESUMO: O DESENVOLVIMENTO E ENTENDIMENTO DO COACHING É FUNDAMENTAL EM UMA ERA DA COMPETITIVIDADE. PARA ISSO, É NECESSÁRIO ALINHAR AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS PARA FACILITAR OS TRABALHOS DOS COACHES, UTILIZANDO TÉCNICAS E FERRAMENTAS AUTÔNOMAS ESPECIFICAS PARA MELHORAR O DESEMPENHO DO PROCESSO. EM DECORRÊNCIA DESTA INVESTIGAÇÃO, PROCUROU-SE VERIFICAR COMO O PROCESSO DE COACHING ACONTECE, QUAIS SÃO OS ATORES ENVOLVIDOS, QUAIS SÃO AS ÁREAS DE ATUAÇÃO DO COACHING E A CREDIBILIDADE DO PRESTADOR DE SERVIÇO, TENDO EM VISTA QUE O COACHING NÃO É SIMPLESMENTE UMA TÉCNICA A SER APLICADA EM UMA DETERMINADA SITUAÇÃO E SIM UM MODO DE ACOMPANHAMENTO DE METAS PESSOAIS E PROFISSIONAIS DE SEUS CLIENTES, BUSCANDO A ALTA PERFORMANCE. NESSE SENTIDO, ESTE TRABALHO BUSCOU ESTRUTURAR UM PROCESSO DE DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE DE SUPORTE À ATUAÇÃO DO COACH. PARA ISSO, O MODELO DE NEGÓCIOS DO COACHING FOI ANALISADO À LUZ DA METODOLOGIA BUSINESS MODEL CANVAS. COMO RESULTADO, FORAM IDENTIFICADAS AS FUNCIONALIDADES PRINCIPAIS PARA A CRIAÇÃO DO SOFTWARE E MODELOS DE MONETIZAÇÃO, COMO TAMBÉM AS LACUNAS DE APERFEIÇOAMENTO DO PROCESSO DE COACHING. AS FUNCIONALIDADES PROPOSTAS PARA O SOFTWARE A SER DESENVOLVIDO POSSIBILITARÃO O CRESCIMENTO PARA TODOS OS ENVOLVIDOS.

NM_PROJETO: DESENVOLVIMENTO REGIONAL: ANÁLISE ECONÔMICA, SOCIAL E DE PERFORMANCE
DS_PALAVRA_CHAVE: CIDADES INTELIGENTES;SMART CITIES;CIDADÃOS INTELIGENTES;SMART CITIZEN;CAPITAL SOCIAL;PARTICIPAÇÃO SOCIAL
DS_ABSTRACT: THE STUDIES ON SMART CITIES SHOW A CONSENSUS ON THE IMPORTANCE OF CITIZEN ENGAGEMENT FOR THE SUCCESS OF THE STRATEGY. HOWEVER, THERE ARE FEW STUDIES ON THE ROLE OF THE SMART CITIZEN IN ESTABLISHING THIS NEW GLOBAL FORM OF CITY PLANNING THAT CAN NOT BE CONFUSED WITH THE DIGITAL CITY. IT IS WORTH EMPHASIZING THAT THE FOCUS ON THE TECHNOLOGICAL TOOLS TO HAVE AN INTELLIGENT CITY CONTRIBUTES TO INCREASE THE EXISTING GAP OF THE ABSENCE OF STUDIES ON THE CITIZEN, TRUE PROTAGONIST OF THE HISTORY OF ANY MODEL OR ADJECTIVE THAT IS GIVEN TO A CITY. ANOTHER IMPORTANT WEAKNESS IN THE DEBATE OF INTELLIGENT CITIES IS THE FACT THAT THE CONCEPT OF INTELLIGENCE APPROACHES THE PSYCHOMETRIC THEORY NO LONGER VALUED BY SCIENCE, INSTEAD OF ENTERING INTO THE COGNITIVE LOGIC THAT PRESENTS INTELLIGENCE AS A SOLUTION OF PROBLEMS ACCORDING TO EACH SOCIAL AND CULTURAL REALITY. DESPITE THIS CONCEPTUAL HIJACKING, THE USE OF THE TERM INTELLIGENT CAN LEAD CITIES TO A PARTICIPATORY REVOLUTION WHERE TECHNOLOGIES CAN BE USED AS A MEANS TO STRENGTHEN DEMOCRATIC INSTITUTIONS AND INTERMEDIARY ORGANIZATIONS OF SOCIETY. SOME AUTHORS POINT OUT THAT SOCIAL PARTICIPATION WITHOUT THE INTERMEDIATION OF INSTITUTIONS OF SOCIETY CAN BE MORE HARMFUL THAN BENEFICIAL TO CITIES. THE EUROPEAN MODEL OF INTELLIGENT CITIES (GIFFINGER ET AL, 2010) PROPOSES SOME FACTORS AND CHARACTERISTICS FOR THESE CITIES AND FOR THEIR CITIZENS WITH EMPHASIS ON SOCIAL CAPITAL. ON THE OTHER HAND, STUDIES BY PUTNAM (1993) CORROBORATE THAT ORGANIZATIONS OF CITIZENS POTENTIATE THE DEVELOPMENT OF CITIES. THUS, STARTING FROM THE UNDERSTANDING THAT THE SIMPLE ENGAGEMENT OF MASSES OF CITIZENS IN THE POLITICAL LIFE OF THE CITY CAN STRENGTHEN CITIZEN CONSERVATISM WITHOUT INTELLECTUAL BASES, BUT THAT SOCIAL PARTICIPATION IS CRUCIAL FOR INTELLIGENT CITIES, THE STUDY SEEKS TO DESCRIBE THE IMPORTANCE OF PRIVATE ORGANIZATIONS OF CITIZENS IN THE FORMATION OF SOCIAL CAPITAL THAT FORMS INTELLIGENT CITIZENS. THE RESEARCH STARTS FROM THEORETICAL ASSUMPTIONS THAT INDIVIDUAL PARTICIPATION IS QUALITATIVELY INFERIOR TO NON-INSTITUTIONAL COLLECTIVE PARTICIPATION, BUT THAT INSTITUTIONAL COLLECTIVE PARTICIPATION IS SUPERIOR TO THE TWO PREVIOUS FORMS, THUS IT HAS GREATER POTENTIAL TO GENERATE SOCIAL CAPITAL NECESSARY FOR INTELLIGENT CITIES. THE SURVEY WAS BASED ON THREE TRADITIONAL SOCIAL ORGANIZATIONS IN THE POLITICAL-ADMINISTRATIVE REGION (RPA) OF RECIFE WITH MORE SOCIO-ECONOMIC INEQUALITIES, TWO OF THEM IN NEEDY AREAS AND ONE IN NOBLE AREA. REGARDLESS OF THE SOCIO-ECONOMIC DISPARITIES IN THE INSTITUTIONS AND NEIGHBORHOODS (RICH OR POOR), THE RESEARCH IDENTIFIED THAT CSOS CONTRIBUTE TO MAKING CITIES SMARTER FROM INTELLIGENT LIVING FACTORS AS WELL AS CHARACTERISTICS TO TRAIN THE SMART CITIZEN. THESE SOCIAL ORGANIZATIONS IN THE CITY ARE ABLE TO GENERATE SOCIAL CAPITAL IN THE COMMUNITY TO FORM INTELLIGENT CITIZENS COMMITTED TO THE PROSPERITY OF THEIR RESIDENTS, MAKING THEM UNIQUE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF SMART CITIES.
